definition_zh: 隐士；主动离群索居的人
definition_en: a person who lives apart from other people, often by choice or by vow
core_image: 林子边缘一间窗帘常年不拉开的小屋，只有清晨烟囱里升起一缕烟
scene: 山脚那间小屋的窗帘从不拉开，只有清晨烟囱里升起一缕烟。The recluse kept a garden and spoke to no one.
sceneCN: 这里 recluse 指隐士（第 1 个义项：主动离群独居的人）；句意为山脚那间小屋的窗帘从不拉开，那位隐士只照料园子，不与人说话。

senses.title: The recluse in the hills
senses.definition: a person who has withdrawn from society under a vow or for ascetic reasons
senses.definitionCN: 因誓愿或苦修而退出社会的人
senses.example: The recluse in the hills had not left his valley in years.
senses.exampleCN: 山中的那位隐士已经多年没有离开山谷。
senses.why: The first sense carries a purpose: the withdrawal is chosen and disciplined.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项带着目的：退隐是主动的、有戒律的。

senses.title: A recluse by temperament
senses.definition: someone who avoids company because other people have become hard to bear
senses.definitionCN: 因为难以忍受他人而回避交往的人
senses.example: After the trial she became a recluse in her own city.
senses.exampleCN: 那场审判之后，她成了自己城市里的避世者。
senses.why: Here the cause is injury or exhaustion, not a vow.
senses.whyCN: 这里的起因是受伤或疲惫，而不是誓愿。

intro.en: Recluse comes from Late Latin reclusus, 'shut away', built from re- and claudere, 'to close'.
intro.cn: recluse 来自晚期拉丁语 reclusus（被关起来的），由 re- 加 claudere（关闭）构成。

items.en: Claudere meant to close or shut.
items.cn: claudere 意为关闭、合上。

items.en: The compound first meant to open, then to shut someone away.
items.cn: 这个复合词先指打开，后来指把人关起来。

items.en: The participle named a person cut off from the world.
items.cn: 这个分词指与世界隔断的人。

items.en: Recluses were sometimes walled into a cell for life.
items.cn: 中世纪的隐士有时被砌进小屋度过一生。

items.en: Today the word covers anyone who avoids company.
items.cn: 今天这个词覆盖任何回避人群的人。

note.en: The look-alike group is the clus- family of closing; the near-meaning group separates hermit, anchorite, loner and shut-in.
note.cn: 形近组是表示「关闭」的 clus 词族；近义组把「隐士」「苦修隐者」「独来独往者」「闭门者」分开。

entries.definition: to shut in, hence to contain.
an enclosed walk in a monastery.
one who lives alone, often for religion.
entries.definitionCN: 独居者，常出于宗教原因。

entries.definition: a religious person shut away in a cell.
a person who prefers to be alone.
a person who cannot or will not leave home.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a curtain that never opens onto the lane.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一幅从不对着小路拉开的窗帘」的画面。

normal.en: Recluse is re plus clus, a door closed over and over.
normal.cn: recluse 是 re 加 clus：一扇被反复关上的门。

normal.en: Picture the curtain that never opens onto the lane.
normal.cn: 想象那幅从不对着小路拉开的窗帘。

normal.en: Say rih-KLOOS; the long vowel is the long silence.
normal.cn: 读 rih-KLOOS，长元音就是那漫长的沉默。

normal.en: The word asks what was closed, not who did the closing.
normal.cn: 这个词问的是关上了什么，而不是谁去关的。

normal.en: A recluse is not merely alone; the aloneness is kept up.
normal.cn: 隐士不只是独自一人，那份独处是被维持住的。

abstract.en: To be a recluse is to make absence into a daily practice.
abstract.cn: 做隐士就是把缺席变成每日的功课。

abstract.en: Every recluse answers a question the world asked too loudly.
abstract.cn: 每个隐士都在回答世界问得太响的一个问题。

abstract.en: The shut door preserves a self that company would spend.
abstract.cn: 那扇关着的门保存着一个会被人群耗尽的自我。

examples.en: The recluse kept a garden and spoke to no one.
examples.cn: 那位隐士只照料园子，不与人说话。

examples.en: The recluse in the hills had not left his valley in years.
examples.cn: 山中的那位隐士已经多年没有离开山谷。

examples.en: After the trial she became a recluse in her own city.
examples.cn: 那场审判之后，她成了自己城市里的避世者。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（向内、回）+ clus（关闭）→ 把自己关起来、不再出门的人。

root: 拉丁语 recludere（关起来）→ re- + claudere（关闭）

sensesIntro.en: Two senses share one closed door: a withdrawal chosen as discipline, and a withdrawal forced by pain.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项共享同一扇关着的门：作为修行而选择的退隐，以及因痛苦而被迫的退避。

chain: A HUT AT THE WOODS EDGE

branches.en: The vowed ascetic who chooses the shut door.
branches.cn: 立誓苦修、主动关上那扇门的人。

branches.en: The wounded person who retreats from company.
branches.cn: 因受伤而退出人群的人。

branches.en: The same silence, reached by different roads.
branches.cn: 同一种沉默，由不同的路走到。

branches.en: Discipline keeps the first one indoors.
branches.cn: 戒律把第一个留在屋里。

branches.en: Shame keeps the second one indoors.
branches.cn: 羞耻把第二个留在屋里。

intro.en: The clus- family turns on closing: seclude shuts apart, exclude shuts out, include shuts in, and a cloister is an enclosed walk.
intro.cn: clus 词族围绕「关闭」：seclude 隔开，exclude 关在外面，include 围进来，cloister 是一条封闭的回廊。

latinIntro.en: Latin claudere supplies the closing; re- adds the backward turn, and recludere in late use meant to shut a person away.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 claudere 提供「关闭」；re- 加上往回的转折，recludere 在晚期用法里指把人关起来。

items.meaning: one shut away from the world
the state of being shut away
to shut in, hence to contain
to shut together, hence to end
a closed walk in a monastery
items.exampleCN: 一条安静的修道院回廊。

definition_zh: （枪炮的）后坐；弹回；退缩；反噬
definition_en: the backward movement of a fired gun, and any springing or shrinking back
core_image: 枪托撞在肩窝上，整个人被推得往后半步，瞄准线随之抬高
scene: 猎枪一响，肩窝被枪托顶得往后一顿，瞄准线也跟着偏了。The recoil bruised his shoulder before he could fire again.
sceneCN: 这里 recoil 指后坐（第 1 个义项：枪炮击发时的向后反冲）；句意为猎枪一响，肩窝被枪托顶得往后一顿，他还没能再开一枪就先被撞伤了。

senses.title: The recoil of a rifle
senses.definition: the backward push of a firearm at the moment of firing
senses.definitionCN: 枪械击发瞬间向后的推力
senses.example: The recoil of the old rifle left a bruise for a week.
senses.exampleCN: 那支旧步枪的后坐留下了一块淤青，整整一周才消。
senses.why: This is the physical sense the word was born for.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词诞生时所指的物理义。

senses.title: To recoil like a spring
senses.definition: to spring back after being stretched, compressed or struck
senses.definitionCN: 在被拉伸、压缩或撞击之后弹回原位
senses.example: The rope recoiled and threw the hook back at him.
senses.exampleCN: 绳子弹了回来，把钩子甩回到他身上。
senses.why: The same backward motion, now in a machine rather than a gun.
senses.whyCN: 同样是向后的运动，只是发生在机械而不是枪上。

senses.title: To recoil from a sight
senses.definition: to shrink back in fear, disgust or shock
senses.definitionCN: 因恐惧、厌恶或震惊而向后缩
senses.example: She recoiled from the offered hand as if it were hot.
senses.exampleCN: 她像被烫到一样，从伸过来的那只手边退缩。
senses.why: Fear borrows the body's backward motion.
senses.whyCN: 恐惧借用了身体的向后运动。

senses.title: The blow recoiled upon him
senses.definition: of a consequence, to come back upon the person who caused it
senses.definitionCN: 指后果回落到造成它的人身上
senses.example: The insult recoiled upon the man who had spoken it.
senses.exampleCN: 那句侮辱反噬到了说出口的那个人身上。
senses.why: The image turns moral: the shot hits the one who fired.
senses.whyCN: 这个意象转向道德：那一枪打中了开枪的人。

intro.en: Recoil comes from Old French reculer, 'to move backwards', built on cul, the rear of the body.
intro.cn: recoil 来自古法语 reculer（向后退），构词基于 cul（身体的后部）。

items.en: Culus named the rump, the rear of the body.
items.cn: culus 指臀部，即身体的后部。

items.en: Reculer meant to back up, the way a horse backs up.
items.cn: reculer 意为后退，就像马向后退。

items.en: English applied the verb to the kick of a gun.
items.cn: 英语把这个动词用到枪的踢击上。

items.en: Recoil then named the force and the distance of that kick.
items.cn: recoil 随后指那股力和那一段距离。

items.en: Later it also described shrinking from a sight.
items.cn: 后来它也描述因所见而退缩。

note.en: The look-alike group is the rec- verbs; the near-meaning group separates rebound, flinch, wince and kickback.
note.cn: 形近组是 rec 开头的动词；近义组把「弹回」「畏缩」「龇牙皱眉」「反冲／回扣」分开。

entries.definition: to set down in writing or sound.
to draw back from pain or fear.
to shrink at a small pain.
entries.definitionCN: 因轻微疼痛而皱眉缩身。

entries.definition: the backward thrust of a mechanism.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a shoulder taking the stock like a door taking a slam.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「肩膀像门被撞上一样接下枪托」的画面。

normal.en: Recoil is re plus cul, the rear of the body: the gun moves rearward.
normal.cn: recoil 是 re 加 cul（身体后部）：枪向后走。

normal.en: Picture the shoulder taking the stock like a door taking a slam.
normal.cn: 想象肩膀像被门撞上那样接下枪托。

normal.en: Say rih-KOIL; it rhymes with the coil that springs back.
normal.cn: 读 rih-KOIL，与弹回的 coil 押韵。

normal.en: The same word covers guns, ropes and human flinching.
normal.cn: 同一个词覆盖枪、绳子和人的退缩。

normal.en: Ask what pushes back, and what that push costs the body.
normal.cn: 问是什么在反推，这份反推又要身体付出什么。

abstract.en: Recoil is the price a force pays to its own source.
abstract.cn: 后坐是一股力付给它自身来源的代价。

abstract.en: Every action leaves a backward shadow we must stand in.
abstract.cn: 每个动作都留下一个向后的影子，我们必须站在其中。

abstract.en: Morally, recoil means the shot finds the shooter.
abstract.cn: 在道德上，后坐意味着子弹找到了开枪的人。

examples.en: The recoil of the old rifle left a bruise for a week.
examples.cn: 那支旧步枪的后坐留下了一块淤青，整整一周才消。

examples.en: The rope recoiled and threw the hook back at him.
examples.cn: 绳子弹了回来，把钩子甩回到他身上。

examples.en: The insult recoiled upon the man who had spoken it.
examples.cn: 那句侮辱反噬到了说出口的那个人身上。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）+ cul（身体后部）→ 开火时整个人往身体后部退的那一下。

root: 古法语 reculer（后退）→ re- + 拉丁语 culus（身体后部）

sensesIntro.en: Four senses follow one backward motion: a gun's kick, a spring's return, a body's flinch, and blame returning to its author.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项沿着同一种向后的运动：枪的后坐、弹簧的弹回、身体的退缩，以及责备回到发出者身上。

branches.en: The gun's own backward push.
branches.cn: 枪自身的向后推力。

branches.en: A spring or a rope returning to shape.
branches.cn: 弹簧或绳索恢复原状。

branches.en: The body's retreat from something unbearable.
branches.cn: 身体对难以忍受之物的退避。

branches.en: Blame coming back to the one who spoke.
branches.cn: 责备回到说出口的那个人。

branches.en: One push is physical, the other moral.
branches.cn: 一个是物理的推，一个是道德的推。

intro.en: The word's family is small: an old French verb of retreating, plus modern compounds for guns and springs.
intro.cn: 这个词的家族不大：一个表示后退的古法语动词，加上一些关于枪与弹簧的现代复合词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is culus, the rear; French reculer meant to back away, and English kept that image for firing guns.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语词根是 culus（后部）；法语 reculer 意为后退，英语把这一意象留给了开枪。

items.meaning: the spring that returns the action

definition_zh: 重组；重新组合；（基因）重组
definition_en: the process of joining separated parts again, especially fragments of genetic material
core_image: 两段不同颜色的绳结被拆成散股，又重新编成一个从没出现过的新花纹
scene: 实验室把两段切开的基因序列重新拼在一起，接出了一个谁也没见过的组合。The recombination of the two strains produced a virus no one had seen.
sceneCN: 这里 recombination 指基因重组（第 2 个义项：遗传物质片段的重新组合）；句意为实验室把两段切开的基因序列重新拼接，产生了谁也没见过的病毒。

pos.zh: 重组；重新组合；（基因）重组

senses.title: The recombination of parts
senses.definition: the act of putting separated components back into one arrangement
senses.definitionCN: 把已经分开的部件重新配到一起
senses.example: The recombination of the two designs solved the vibration problem.
senses.exampleCN: 两套设计的重新组合解决了振动问题。
senses.why: The first sense is general: any set of parts may be recombined.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是泛指的：任何一组部件都可以重新组合。

senses.title: Genetic recombination
senses.definition: the reshuffling of DNA fragments into new combinations during reproduction or in the laboratory
senses.definitionCN: 在繁殖过程或实验室里把 DNA 片段重新搭配成新的组合
senses.example: Recombination during meiosis shuffles the genes of both parents.
senses.exampleCN: 减数分裂时的基因重组把双亲的基因重新洗牌。
senses.why: Here the parts are inherited, and the new order is biological.
senses.whyCN: 这里的部件是遗传来的，新的次序是生物性的。

senses.title: The recombination of ions
senses.definition: the rejoining of positive and negative ions into neutral particles
senses.definitionCN: 正负离子重新结合成中性粒子
senses.example: Recombination of ions in the chamber lowered the current.
senses.exampleCN: 腔内的离子复合使电流下降。
senses.why: Physics uses the same word for charged pieces losing their charge.
senses.whyCN: 物理学用同一个词指带电的碎片彼此中和。

intro.en: Recombination is re-, 'again', plus combination, from Latin combinare, 'to join two by two'.
intro.cn: recombination 是 re-（再次）加 combination，后者来自拉丁语 combinare（把两个连在一起）。

items.en: Bini meant two together, a pair.
items.cn: bini 意为两个一起，即一对。

items.en: Combinare meant to join two things into one.
items.cn: combinare 意为把两样东西连成一体。

items.en: English combine kept the plain sense of joining.
items.cn: 英语的 combine 保留了「连接」的本义。

items.en: The prefix repeats the joining after a separation.
items.cn: 前缀表示在分开之后再连一次。

items.en: Genetics and physics gave the word its technical life.
items.cn: 遗传学与物理学给了这个词技术性的生命。

note.en: The look-alike group is the combin- family; the near-meaning group separates rearrangement, reshuffle, crossing over and reassortment.
note.cn: 形近组是 combin 词族；近义组把「重新排列」「重新洗牌」「染色体交换」「重配」分开。

entries.definitionCN: 与集合的排列组合有关的。

entries.definition: a new ordering of the same items.
a mixing into a new order.
the exchange of DNA between paired chromosomes.
entries.definitionCN: 成对染色体之间交换 DNA。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of two coloured cords unwound and braided into a pattern that did not exist before.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「两根不同颜色的绳子被拆开，又编成此前不存在的新花纹」的画面。

normal.en: Recombination is combination performed a second time.
normal.cn: recombination 就是把 combination 再做一遍。

normal.en: Picture a braid undone and redone with the strands swapped.
normal.cn: 想象一条辫子被拆开，换着股重新编。

normal.en: Say ree-kom-bih-NAY-shun; the stress sits on NAY.
normal.cn: 读 ree-kom-bih-NAY-shun，重音落在 NAY。

normal.en: The word always needs two parents, two halves or two parts.
normal.cn: 这个词总需要两个亲本、两个半边或两个部分。

normal.en: Ask what was separated first, because recombination follows a split.
normal.cn: 先问是什么被分开了，因为重组总是跟着一次分离。

abstract.en: Recombination is heredity admitting that order can be rebuilt.
abstract.cn: 重组是遗传承认次序可以被重新搭建。

abstract.en: Every new combination is an old argument between two sets of parts.
abstract.cn: 每一个新组合都是两套部件之间的一场旧争论。

abstract.en: The word belongs to any age that can take things apart cleanly.
abstract.cn: 这个词属于任何能把东西干净拆开的时代。

examples.en: The recombination of the two designs solved the vibration problem.
examples.cn: 两套设计的重新组合解决了振动问题。

examples.en: Recombination during meiosis shuffles the genes of both parents.
examples.cn: 减数分裂时的基因重组把双亲的基因重新洗牌。

examples.en: Recombination of ions in the chamber lowered the current.
examples.cn: 腔内的离子复合使电流下降。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（再）+ combination（把两个连在一起）→ 分开的部件再连一次，连出新组合。

root: 拉丁语 combinare（把两个连在一起）→ re-（再次）+ combinatio（结合）

sensesIntro.en: Three senses rejoin what had been split: mechanical parts, inherited genes, and charged ions.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项把被拆开的东西重新接上：机械部件、遗传基因，以及带电离子。

core.cn: 重新编成一股的两根绳

branches.en: Any set of parts put back in a new order.
branches.cn: 任何一组被重新排序的部件。

branches.en: Inherited fragments shuffled by sex or by hand.
branches.cn: 被有性生殖或人工操作洗牌的遗传片段。

branches.en: Charged particles losing their charge together.
branches.cn: 带电粒子一起失去电荷。

branches.en: One is workshop practice, the other is biology.
branches.cn: 一个是车间做法，另一个是生物学。

branches.en: Both are invisible parts finding partners.
branches.cn: 两者都是看不见的部件找到了配对者。

intro.en: The combin- family is about pairing: combine, combination, recombinant and recombination all keep the image of two things made one.
intro.cn: combin 词族讲的是配对：combine、combination、recombinant、recombination 都保留「两物合为一体」的意象。

latinIntro.en: Latin bini, 'two together', yields combinare, 'to join a pair'; re- simply runs the joining after a split.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 bini（两个一起）生出 combinare（把一对连起来）；re- 只是在分开之后再连一次。

definition_zh: 求助；依靠；追索权
definition_en: the act of turning to something for help, or the legal right to demand payment
core_image: 一条路走到尽头，行人折回去敲响那扇唯一还亮着灯的窗
scene: 账上已经没有现金，公司只好回头向银行求助。Without cash, the firm had recourse to its bank.
sceneCN: 这里 recourse 指求助、诉诸（第 1 个义项：把某物当作求助的对象）；句意为账上已经没有现金，公司只好向银行求助。

senses.title: To have recourse to help
senses.definition: to turn to something or someone as a means of help
senses.definitionCN: 把某物或某人当作求助的手段
senses.example: Without cash, the firm had recourse to its bank.
senses.exampleCN: 账上已经没有现金，公司只好向银行求助。
senses.why: The first sense is active: someone chooses to turn back for help.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是主动的：有人选择折回去寻求帮助。

senses.title: A right of recourse
senses.definition: the legal right to demand payment from a guarantor or from the goods sold
senses.definitionCN: 向保证人或者已售货物要求清偿的法定权利
senses.example: The contract kept a right of recourse against the guarantor.
senses.exampleCN: 合同保留了对保证人的追索权。
senses.why: Law turns the turning-back into an enforceable claim.
senses.whyCN: 法律把「折回去」变成一项可以强制执行的请求权。

senses.title: A last recourse
senses.definition: the final source of help when every other option has failed
senses.definitionCN: 其他办法都用尽之后最后可依仗的东西
senses.example: Surgery was the last recourse after the drugs failed.
senses.exampleCN: 药物失效之后，手术成了最后的办法。
senses.why: Here recourse names the thing itself, not the act of turning to it.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项指所依靠的东西本身，而不是求助的动作。

intro.en: Recourse comes from Latin recursus, 'a running back', from recurrere, 'to run back'.
intro.cn: recourse 来自拉丁语 recursus（跑回去），源头是 recurrere（跑回）。

items.en: Currere meant to run.
items.cn: currere 意为跑。

items.en: Recurrere meant to run back, to return.
items.cn: recurrere 意为跑回去、返回。

items.en: The noun named a running back to a source.
items.cn: 这个名词指跑回源头。

items.en: English law made it a right to demand payment.
items.cn: 英国法律把它变成要求清偿的权利。

items.en: Today it means any source of help in difficulty.
items.cn: 今天它指困境中可以依靠的任何东西。

note.en: The look-alike group is the curr- family; the near-meaning group separates resort, appeal, refuge and expedient.
note.cn: 形近组是 curr 词族；近义组把「求助对象」「上诉」「避难所」「权宜手段」分开。

entries.definition: a place or course turned to for help.
entries.definitionCN: 求助时转向的地方或途径。

entries.definition: a request for a decision or help.
a practical means used for a purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 为达到目的的实用手段。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a road ending and a traveller running back to the one lit window.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「路走到尽头，行人跑回那扇唯一亮着灯的窗」的画面。

normal.en: Recourse is a running back: re plus the course you ran.
normal.cn: recourse 是跑回去：re 加上你跑过的那条路。

normal.en: Picture the road ending and one window still lit.
normal.cn: 想象路到了尽头，只有一扇窗还亮着。

normal.en: Say rih-KORSS; the sound is a short, firm turn.
normal.cn: 读 rih-KORSS，声音短促而坚决，像一次折返。

normal.en: Legally, recourse is the turn that can be enforced.
normal.cn: 在法律上，recourse 是可以强制执行的那次折返。

normal.en: The word implies that ordinary means have failed.
normal.cn: 这个词意味着寻常办法已经行不通了。

abstract.en: Recourse is what a person does when the map runs out.
abstract.cn: 求助是地图用尽之后人所做的事。

abstract.en: Every right of recourse assumes someone else can be made to pay.
abstract.cn: 每一项追索权都预设可以把代价推给别人。

abstract.en: A last recourse is the hope that remains after planning stops.
abstract.cn: 最后的办法是计划停止之后仍然留下的那份指望。

examples.en: Without cash, the firm had recourse to its bank.
examples.cn: 账上已经没有现金，公司只好向银行求助。

examples.en: The contract kept a right of recourse against the guarantor.
examples.cn: 合同保留了对保证人的追索权。

examples.en: Surgery was the last recourse after the drugs failed.
examples.cn: 药物失效之后，手术成了最后的办法。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）+ course（跑、路线）→ 路走不通了就跑回去找那扇还亮着的窗。

root: 拉丁语 recurrere（跑回）→ re- + currere（跑）

sensesIntro.en: Three senses follow the same turn: the act of seeking help, the legal right to claim, and the last thing left to rely on.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项沿着同一次折返：寻求帮助的动作、可以主张的法律权利，以及最后能依靠的东西。

core.en: THE ROAD TURNS BACK TO HELP

branches.en: Turning to a person or thing for aid.
branches.cn: 转向某人某物以求援助。

branches.en: The same turn written into a contract.
branches.cn: 同一次折返被写进合同。

branches.en: The final object on which hope rests.
branches.cn: 希望所寄托的最后一件东西。

branches.en: Practice and law share one verb of returning.
branches.cn: 实践与法律共享同一个「返回」的动词。

branches.en: Both are what remains when other means fail.
branches.cn: 两者都是其他办法失效后剩下来的东西。

intro.en: The curr- family is about running: recur means run back again, and recourse is the noun of that run.
intro.cn: curr 词族讲的是跑：recur 是再跑回来，recourse 是这次跑回来的名词形式。

latinIntro.en: Latin currere, 'to run', gives recurrere, 'to run back'; recourse keeps the noun recursus, a running back for aid.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 currere（跑）生出 recurrere（跑回）；recourse 保留了名词 recursus，即跑回去求援。

items.meaning: to run back, to happen again
a return of the same event
a running out on a trip

definition_zh: 康复；找回；回升；恢复（能力或意识）
definition_en: to get back health, an object, a level or a faculty that had been lost
core_image: 病床上的人先能坐起，再能下地，最后自己走到窗边把窗帘拉开
scene: 病床上的孩子退了烧，先能坐起来喝汤，后来自己走到了窗边。Within a week the boy had recovered enough to walk to the window.
sceneCN: 这里 recover 指康复（第 1 个义项：从疾病中恢复健康）；句意为病床上的孩子退了烧，一周之内就能自己走到窗边。

senses.title: To recover from illness
senses.definition: to return to health after sickness or injury
senses.definitionCN: 在生病或受伤之后重新健康起来
senses.example: Within a week the boy had recovered enough to walk to the window.
senses.exampleCN: 一周之内，男孩已经恢复到能自己走到窗边。
senses.why: The first sense is about a body returning to its own normal.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是身体回到自己的常态。

senses.title: To recover a lost object
senses.definition: to get back something that had been lost or taken
senses.definitionCN: 重新取得丢失或被拿走的东西
senses.example: The police recovered the paintings from a warehouse.
senses.exampleCN: 警方从一个仓库里追回了那些画。
senses.why: Here the thing was outside the owner's hands and comes back.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项里，东西原本不在主人手里，现在回来了。

senses.title: To recover a market level
senses.definition: of prices, shares or trade, to rise back after a fall
senses.definitionCN: 指价格、股价或交易在下跌之后涨回来
senses.example: Steel prices recovered in the spring after a poor winter.
senses.exampleCN: 钢材价格在惨淡的冬天之后于春天回升。
senses.why: The sense is statistical: a line on a chart turns upward.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项是统计性的：图表上的线重新向上。

senses.title: To recover one's senses
senses.definition: to regain a faculty such as consciousness, balance or composure
senses.definitionCN: 重新取得意识、平衡或镇定这类能力
senses.example: He recovered his balance on the icy step and went on.
senses.exampleCN: 他在结冰的台阶上恢复平衡，继续往前走。
senses.why: The object is inside the person, not in the world.
senses.whyCN: 这里的宾语在人的内部，而不在外部世界。

intro.en: Recover comes from Old French recovrer, from Latin recuperare, 'to regain'.
intro.cn: recover 来自古法语 recovrer，源头是拉丁语 recuperare（重新取得）。

items.en: Recuperare meant to get back what had been lost.
items.cn: recuperare 意为取回失去之物。

items.en: Recovrer carried the same sense of regaining.
items.cn: recovrer 保有同样的「重新取得」之义。

items.en: English first used it for a body getting well.
items.cn: 英语最初用它说身体痊愈。

items.en: Markets later made it a word about prices.
items.cn: 商业随后让它成为说价格的词。

items.en: Today it covers objects, faculties and levels alike.
items.cn: 今天它同时覆盖物品、能力和水平。

note.en: The look-alike group separates the hyphenated re-cover from recoup, recount and record; the near-meaning group separates recuperate, regain, rally and bounce back.
note.cn: 形近组把带连字符的 re-cover 与 recoup、recount、record 分开；近义组把「康复」「重新取得」「重整旗鼓」「反弹」分开。

entries.definition: to cover again with a new surface.
to tell a story in detail.
to set down for later use.
to gather strength and return to action.
to return to a former state quickly.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a sick body moving from bed to chair to window in three small steps.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「病中的身体从床到椅子再到窗边，三小步走回来」的画面。

normal.en: Recover is re plus cover: you get the cover back over your own life.
normal.cn: recover 是 re 加 cover：把生活的罩子重新盖回自己身上。

normal.en: Picture the three steps: bed, chair, window.
normal.cn: 想象那三小步：床、椅子、窗。

normal.en: Say rih-KUV-er; the middle vowel is short and closed.
normal.cn: 读 rih-KUV-er，中间那个元音短而闭。

normal.en: The word asks what was lost and from whom it returns.
normal.cn: 这个词问的是丢了什么，又从谁那里回来。

normal.en: Recovery is slow; recover is the single step that starts it.
normal.cn: 康复是缓慢的，recover 是开始它的那一步。

abstract.en: To recover is to prove that a break was not a permanent shape.
abstract.cn: 恢复就是证明一次断裂并不是永久的形状。

abstract.en: Markets and bodies both lie about their own equilibrium.
abstract.cn: 市场与身体都会对自己的平衡撒谎。

abstract.en: The word holds loss, return and time in one syllable of re.
abstract.cn: 这个词用一个 re 装下了失去、返回与时间。

examples.en: Within a week the boy had recovered enough to walk to the window.
examples.cn: 一周之内，男孩已经恢复到能自己走到窗边。

examples.en: The police recovered the paintings from a warehouse.
examples.cn: 警方从一个仓库里追回了那些画。

examples.en: Steel prices recovered in the spring after a poor winter.
examples.cn: 钢材价格在惨淡的冬天之后于春天回升。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）+ cover（盖住、覆盖）→ 把失去的那层东西重新盖回自己身上。

root: 拉丁语 recuperare（重新取得）→ 古法语 recovrer

sensesIntro.en: Four senses bring four different things back: health, an object, a price, and a faculty inside a person.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项分别带回了四样东西：健康、物品、价格，以及一个人内在的能力。

branches.en: The body returning to its own normal.
branches.cn: 身体回到自己的常态。

branches.en: An object returning to its owner.
branches.cn: 物品回到主人手里。

branches.en: A price line turning upward again.
branches.cn: 价格曲线重新向上。

branches.en: A faculty returning inside the person.
branches.cn: 某种能力在人的内部回来。

branches.en: Health and composure are both recoveries of self.
branches.cn: 健康与镇定都是自我的恢复。

intro.en: The recover- family is about getting back: recovery, recoverable and irrecoverable all measure whether a return is possible.
intro.cn: recover 词族讲的是取回：recovery、recoverable、irrecoverable 都在衡量返回是否可能。

latinIntro.en: Latin recuperare, 'to regain', gives the whole family; the re- is not repeated in English, but the sense of return is.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 recuperare（重新取得）给出整个词族；英语里并不重复那个 re-，但「返回」的意思仍在。

items.meaning: to get back what was lost

definition_zh: 怯懦的；背信的；懦夫；叛徒
definition_en: cowardly and disloyal, or a person who yields or betrays a cause
core_image: 骑士看见对面的长矛阵，把盾牌扔在泥里，转身向后退
scene: 那位骑士看见对面的长矛阵，扔下盾牌，向对方讨饶。The recreant knight threw down his shield and asked for terms.
sceneCN: 这里 recreant 指怯懦退缩的（第 1 个义项：面对危险而退的人）；句意为那位骑士看见长矛阵就扔下盾牌，向对方讨饶。

senses.title: A recreant knight
senses.definition: cowardly, yielding in the face of danger or duty
senses.definitionCN: 怯懦的，在危险或责任面前退让的
senses.example: The recreant knight threw down his shield and asked for terms.
senses.exampleCN: 那位怯懦的骑士扔下盾牌，向对方讨饶。
senses.why: The first sense is about the body stepping back when it should stand.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项讲的是身体在该站住的时候后退了。

senses.title: A recreant cause
senses.definition: disloyal, having abandoned a faith, a vow or a cause
senses.definitionCN: 不忠的，背弃了信仰、誓言或事业的
senses.example: He was called recreant for leaving the order he had sworn to serve.
senses.exampleCN: 他因为离开自己立誓效力的团体而被指为背信。
senses.why: Here the failure is to a promise rather than to a danger.
senses.whyCN: 这里的失败发生在对承诺上，而不是对危险。

senses.title: A recreant in the ranks
senses.definition: a person who yields or deserts and is named as such
senses.definitionCN: 因屈服或逃亡而被这样称呼的人
senses.example: The sergeants kept the names of every recreant in the roll.
senses.exampleCN: 军士们把每个懦夫的名字都记在名册上。
senses.why: The adjective becomes a label fixed on a person.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词变成了贴在一个人身上的名号。

intro.en: Recreant comes from Old French recreant, the participle of recroire, 'to yield or give oneself up'.
intro.cn: recreant 来自古法语 recreant，是 recroire（认输、把自己交出去）的分词。

items.en: Credere meant to believe or to entrust.
items.cn: credere 意为相信或托付。

items.en: Recroire meant to yield and admit defeat.
items.cn: recroire 意为屈服、承认失败。

items.en: The participle named the knight who cried for terms.
items.cn: 这个分词指讨饶的骑士。

items.en: A recreant knight lost honour, land and name.
items.cn: 怯懦的骑士会失去荣誉、土地与名号。

items.en: Today it survives as a literary word for cowardice and betrayal.
items.cn: 今天它作为文学用词，指怯懦与背叛。

note.en: The look-alike group is the recreat- family, which shares letters but not the root; the near-meaning group separates cowardly, dastardly, traitorous and faithless.
note.cn: 形近组是 recreat 词族，它们共享字母却不共享词根；近义组把「怯懦的」「卑劣的」「叛国的」「不忠的」分开。

entries.definition: mean and cowardly in a base way.
guilty of betraying a country or cause.
breaking a promise or a trust.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a shield thrown down in the mud and a knight backing out of the line.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「盾牌扔在泥里，骑士退出队列」的画面。

normal.en: Recreant sounds like re plus cry: the man who cries for terms.
normal.cn: recreant 听来像 re 加 cry：那个喊着要讨饶的人。

normal.en: Picture the shield lying face down in the mud.
normal.cn: 想象那面盾牌脸朝下躺在泥里。

normal.en: Say REE-kree-ant; the first syllable is flat and heavy.
normal.cn: 读 REE-kree-ant，第一个音节平而重。

normal.en: The word covers two failures: the nerve and the vow.
normal.cn: 这个词覆盖两种失败：胆量与誓言。

normal.en: Recreant looks like recreate but shares no root with it.
normal.cn: recreant 看着像 recreate，却与它没有共同词根。

abstract.en: A recreant is a person who lets a line of men break where he stands.
abstract.cn: 懦夫是那个让自己站的那一段阵线断掉的人。

abstract.en: Betrayal is cowardice that found a cause to hide behind.
abstract.cn: 背叛是找到了一个事业可供藏身的怯懦。

abstract.en: The old word survives because armies still keep such rolls.
abstract.cn: 这个老词还在，因为军队仍然记着这样的名册。

examples.en: The recreant knight threw down his shield and asked for terms.
examples.cn: 那位怯懦的骑士扔下盾牌，向对方讨饶。

examples.en: He was called recreant for leaving the order he had sworn to serve.
examples.cn: 他因为离开自己立誓效力的团体而被指为背信。

examples.en: The sergeants kept the names of every recreant in the roll.
examples.cn: 军士们把每个懦夫的名字都记在名册上。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）+ creant（认输者）→ 转身退回去的那个人。

root: 古法语 recroire（认输）→ re- + croire（相信、托付，拉丁语 credere）

sensesIntro.en: Three senses follow one backward step: the coward in danger, the man who breaks his vow, and the name fixed on him afterwards.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项沿着同一次后退：危险中的懦夫、背弃誓言的人，以及事后贴在他身上的名号。

core.en: A SHIELD DROPPED IN THE MUD

branches.en: The nerve failing at the moment of danger.
branches.cn: 在危险来临的一刻胆量崩溃。

branches.en: The vow broken after the danger has passed.
branches.cn: 危险过去之后被违背的誓言。

branches.en: The label that outlives both failures.
branches.cn: 比两种失败活得更久的那个名号。

branches.en: One is fear in the body, the other is disloyalty in the will.
branches.cn: 一个是身体里的恐惧，一个是意志里的不忠。

branches.en: A broken vow becomes a public name.
branches.cn: 被违背的誓言变成公开的名号。

intro.en: The root is Latin credere, 'to believe or entrust': recreant, creed, credible, credence and credit all come from it.
intro.cn: 词根是拉丁语 credere（相信、托付）：recreant、creed、credible、credence、credit 都出自它。

latinIntro.en: French recroire meant to give oneself up, and behind it lies credere; the re- marks the handing back of oneself.
latinIntro.cn: 法语 recroire 意为把自己交出去，背后是 credere；re- 表示把自己交还出去。

latinEntries.meaning: to yield, to give oneself up

definition_zh: 重新创造；再现；使振作（旧义）
definition_en: to make a thing again, to bring an event back before the eyes, or, in older use, to refresh a person
core_image: 烧毁的街景照着唯一一张照片，一间一间重新搭起来
scene: 剧场的布景烧毁之后，工匠照着照片把整条街重新搭了起来。The stage crew recreated the whole street from a single photograph.
sceneCN: 这里 recreate 指重新创造、重建（第 1 个义项：把被毁的东西再做一遍）；句意为布景烧毁之后，工匠照着一张照片把整条街重新搭起来。

senses.title: To recreate a lost thing
senses.definition: to make again something that has been destroyed or discontinued
senses.definitionCN: 把已被毁掉或中断的东西重新做出来
senses.example: The stage crew recreated the whole street from a single photograph.
senses.exampleCN: 舞台工作人员照着一张照片把整条街重新搭了出来。
senses.why: The first sense is about manufacture: the thing did not exist, now it does.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项讲的是制作：东西原本不存在了，现在又存在。

senses.title: To recreate the past
senses.definition: to make a past event happen again in front of an audience or a mind
senses.definitionCN: 让过去的事件在观众或头脑面前再发生一次
senses.example: The film recreates the first crossing in careful detail.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影细致地再现了第一次横渡。
senses.why: Here nothing material is remade; only the appearance returns.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项里没有实物被重造，回来的只是景象。

senses.title: To recreate oneself
senses.definition: in older use, to refresh the spirits of a tired person
senses.definitionCN: 在旧用法中，指让疲惫的人恢复精神
senses.example: A walk by the river recreated him after the long hearing.
senses.exampleCN: 漫长的听证之后，沿河散步让他恢复了些精神。
senses.why: This sense has its own pronunciation and its own history.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项有自己的读音，也有自己的历史。

intro.en: Recreate comes from Latin recreare, 'to make anew or restore', from re- and creare, 'to bring forth'.
intro.cn: recreate 来自拉丁语 recreare（重新造出、恢复），由 re- 加 creare（产生）构成。

items.en: Creare meant to make or bring forth.
items.cn: creare 意为制造、产生。

items.en: The compound meant both to make again and to restore.
items.cn: 这个复合词既指重新制造，也指恢复。

items.en: The hyphen kept the plain sense of making again.
items.cn: 带连字符的写法保留「重新制造」的本义。

items.en: The older verb also meant to restore a person's spirits.
items.cn: 这个较早的动词也指恢复人的精神。

items.en: Dictionaries now separate recreate from re-create.
items.cn: 现代词典把 recreate 与 re-create 分开。

note.en: The look-alike group is the create- family; the near-meaning group separates rebuild, reproduce, restore and refresh.
note.cn: 形近组是 create 词族；近义组把「重建」「复制再现」「修复」「提神」分开。

entries.definition: to create again, spelled with a hyphen.
entries.definitionCN: 再次创造，带连字符书写。

entries.definition: the act of making again, or leisure.
to present again as a copy.
to bring back a former condition.
to make someone feel new energy.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a burnt street rebuilt from one surviving photograph.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一条烧毁的街，靠一张幸存的照片重新搭起来」的画面。

normal.en: Recreate is re plus create: the making happens a second time.
normal.cn: recreate 是 re 加 create：制造发生第二次。

normal.en: Picture one photograph pinned to the wall of a ruined street.
normal.cn: 想象废墟的墙上钉着唯一一张照片。

normal.en: Say ree-KREE-ayt for the making sense, REK-ree-ayt for the old one.
normal.cn: 表示「再造」读 ree-KREE-ayt，旧义读 REK-ree-ayt。

normal.en: The word can rebuild a wall or only a memory of one.
normal.cn: 这个词可以重建一堵墙，也可以只重建关于墙的记忆。

normal.en: Ask whether the copy is meant to fool the eye or serve the use.
normal.cn: 问这个复制品是要骗过眼睛，还是要真的能用。

abstract.en: To recreate is to trust that a form can outlive its material.
abstract.cn: 重新创造就是相信形式能比材料活得更久。

abstract.en: Every reconstruction chooses what to leave out of the past.
abstract.cn: 每一次重建都在选择把过去的哪部分删掉。

abstract.en: The old refresh sense reminds us that people, too, are remade.
abstract.cn: 那个古老的「提神」义提醒我们，人也是被重造的。

examples.en: The stage crew recreated the whole street from a single photograph.
examples.cn: 舞台工作人员照着一张照片把整条街重新搭了出来。

examples.en: The film recreates the first crossing in careful detail.
examples.cn: 这部电影细致地再现了第一次横渡。

examples.en: A walk by the river recreated him after the long hearing.
examples.cn: 漫长的听证之后，沿河散步让他恢复了些精神。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（再）+ create（创造）→ 把已经没了的东西再做一遍。

root: 拉丁语 recreare（重新造出、恢复）→ re- + creare（产生）

sensesIntro.en: Three senses remake three different things: a lost object, a past event, and a tired person's spirits.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项重造的是三样不同的东西：失去的实物、过去的事件，以及疲惫者的精神。

core.cn: 照着一张照片重搭的街

branches.en: A material thing made again.
branches.cn: 被重新做出的实物。

branches.en: An event staged again for the eyes.
branches.cn: 为眼睛再演一次的事件。

branches.en: A tired person's spirits restored.
branches.cn: 疲惫者的精神被恢复。

branches.en: One rebuilds the object, the other rebuilds its appearance.
branches.cn: 一个重造物体，一个重造它的外观。

branches.en: Both restore something that had run out.
branches.cn: 两者都恢复某种已经耗尽的东西。

intro.en: The create- family is about bringing forth: create, creation, creator, recreative and recreation all keep that root.
intro.cn: create 词族讲的是「产生」：create、creation、creator、recreative、recreation 都保留这个词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin creare, 'to bring forth', gives creation; the re- in recreare adds a second bringing forth or a restoring.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 creare（产生）给出 creation；recreare 里的 re- 加上第二次产生，或一次恢复。

definition_zh: 反责；反唇相讥；反诉
definition_en: to answer an accusation by making an accusation of one's own
core_image: 被指着鼻子的人不解释，反而抬起手，把同一根手指指回对方
scene: 会上被点名批评的人没有解释，先反过来指责提问者。Instead of explaining, he began to recriminate against the man who had questioned him.
sceneCN: 这里 recriminate 指反责、反唇相讥（第 1 个义项：被指责时反过来指责对方）；句意为被点名批评的人不作解释，先反过来指责提问者。

senses.title: To recriminate in an argument
senses.definition: to meet one accusation with another accusation
senses.definitionCN: 用一项指控来回应另一项指控
senses.example: Instead of explaining, he began to recriminate against the man who had questioned him.
senses.exampleCN: 他不作解释，反而开始指责那个质问他的人。
senses.why: The first sense is the everyday exchange of blame.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是日常的相互推责。

senses.title: To recriminate in court
senses.definition: to bring a counter-charge against the party who accused one
senses.definitionCN: 对提出指控的一方提出反指控
senses.example: The company recriminated, filing its own claim the same week.
senses.exampleCN: 公司提出反诉，同一周内提交了自己的诉状。
senses.why: Law gives the returned accusation a formal name and a procedure.
senses.whyCN: 法律给这项回敬的指控一个正式名称和一套程序。

intro.en: Recriminate comes from Latin recriminare, 'to accuse back', from re- and criminari, 'to charge'.
intro.cn: recriminate 来自拉丁语 recriminare（反过来指控），由 re- 加 criminari（指控）构成。

items.en: Crimen meant a charge or an accusation.
items.cn: crimen 意为指控或罪名。

items.en: Criminari meant to accuse someone of something.
items.cn: criminari 意为指控某人。

items.en: The compound meant to accuse in return.
items.cn: 这个复合词意为反过来指控。

items.en: English courts used it for a counter-charge.
items.cn: 英国法庭用它指反指控。

items.en: Today it also covers ordinary exchanges of blame.
items.cn: 今天它也覆盖日常的相互推责。

note.en: The look-alike group is the crimin- family; the near-meaning group separates countercharge, retort, counterattack and blame.
note.cn: 形近组是 crimin 词族；近义组把「反指控」「回嘴」「反击」「归咎」分开。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a finger turned back toward the person who pointed it.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一根手指被指回指向它的人」的画面。

normal.en: Recriminate is re plus criminate: the charge comes back.
normal.cn: recriminate 是 re 加 criminate：指控被送回去。

normal.en: Picture one finger pointing and another pointing back.
normal.cn: 想象一根手指指着人，另一根指回来。

normal.en: Say rih-KRIM-ih-nayt; CRIM sits in the middle.
normal.cn: 读 rih-KRIM-ih-nayt，CRIM 在中间。

normal.en: The word never settles the truth; it only moves the blame.
normal.cn: 这个词从不解决真相，只把责任挪个位置。

normal.en: In court the returned accusation needs its own filing.
normal.cn: 在法庭上，回敬的指控需要自己的一份诉状。

abstract.en: To recriminate is to answer a question with a second question.
abstract.cn: 反责就是用第二个问题回答第一个问题。

abstract.en: Mutual accusation is the sound of two people refusing to look inward.
abstract.cn: 相互指责是两个人都拒绝内省时发出的声音。

abstract.en: The word preserves the legal hope that blame can be balanced like a ledger.
abstract.cn: 这个词保留了法律上的希望：责任能像账目一样被冲平。

examples.en: Instead of explaining, he began to recriminate against the man who had questioned him.
examples.cn: 他不作解释，反而开始指责那个质问他的人。

examples.en: The company recriminated, filing its own claim the same week.
examples.cn: 公司提出反诉，同一周内提交了自己的诉状。

examples.en: Both sides spent the afternoon recriminating instead of negotiating.
examples.cn: 双方整个下午都在相互指责，而不是谈判。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）+ criminate（指控）→ 把别人扔过来的指控再扔回去。

root: 拉丁语 recriminare（反过来指控）→ re- + criminari（指控）

sensesIntro.en: Two senses return one accusation: the ordinary exchange of blame, and the formal counter-charge of law.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都在奉还同一项指控：日常生活中相互推责，以及法律上正式的反诉。

branches.en: Blame traded across a table.
branches.cn: 桌子两边交换的责备。

branches.en: The same return written into a court file.
branches.cn: 同一次回敬被写进法庭卷宗。

branches.en: One is temper, the other is procedure.
branches.cn: 一个是脾气，一个是程序。

branches.en: The everyday sense needs no lawyer.
branches.cn: 日常义不需要律师。

branches.en: The legal sense needs a claim of its own.
branches.cn: 法律义需要自己的一份诉状。

intro.en: The crimin- family is about charges: criminate, incriminate, recrimination and recriminatory all accuse someone.
intro.cn: crimin 词族讲的是指控：criminate、incriminate、recrimination、recriminatory 都在指控某人。

latinIntro.en: Latin crimen, 'a charge', yields criminari, 'to accuse'; re- in recriminare turns the accusation back on its author.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 crimen（指控）生出 criminari（指控）；recriminare 里的 re- 把指控转回它的发出者。

definition_zh: 复发的；（疾病或恶事）重新爆发的
definition_en: of a disease or a bad condition, breaking out again after a quiet period
core_image: 刚刚结痂的伤口在夜里又裂开，血重新渗出来
scene: 病房里以为已经退下去的烧，过了些日子又在夜里升了起来。A recrudescent fever kept the ward closed for another month.
sceneCN: 这里 recrudescent 指复发的（第 1 个义项：疾病在平息之后再度发作）；句意为复发的热病让病房又多关闭了一个月。

senses.title: A recrudescent fever
senses.definition: of an illness, returning after a period in which it seemed to have gone
senses.definitionCN: 指疾病在看似已经过去一段时间之后重新出现
senses.example: A recrudescent fever kept the ward closed for another month.
senses.exampleCN: 复发的热病让病房又多关闭了一个月。
senses.why: The first sense is medical: the same illness comes back, not a new one.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是医学的：回来的是同一种病，不是新病。

senses.title: Recrudescent violence
senses.definition: of a bad condition, breaking out again after a lull
senses.definitionCN: 指恶劣的状况在短暂平息之后再次爆发
senses.example: Recrudescent violence in the border towns worried the ministry.
senses.exampleCN: 边境城镇重新爆发的暴力让部里感到不安。
senses.why: The image moves from a body to a society.
senses.whyCN: 这个意象从一具身体移到了一片社会。

intro.en: Recrudescent comes from Latin recrudescere, 'to become raw again', from crudus, 'raw'.
intro.cn: recrudescent 来自拉丁语 recrudescere（重新变得生、重新破开），源于 crudus（生的）。

items.en: Crudus meant raw, unripe, unhealed.
items.cn: crudus 意为生的、未熟的、未愈的。

items.en: Crudescere meant to grow raw or worse.
items.cn: crudescere 意为变得生、变得恶化。

items.en: The compound meant to break open again like a wound.
items.cn: 这个复合词意为像伤口那样重新裂开。

items.en: English first used it of fevers that came back.
items.cn: 英语最初用它说重新回来的热病。

items.en: Today it also covers violence and old conflicts.
items.cn: 今天它也覆盖暴力与旧冲突。

note.en: The look-alike group is the crud- family; the near-meaning group separates recurring, relapsing, resurgent and renewed.
note.cn: 形近组是 crud 词族；近义组把「反复出现的」「病情反复的」「再度兴起的」「重新开始的」分开。

entries.definition: a return of a disease or bad state.
entries.definitionCN: 疾病或恶劣状态的回归。
以新的力量重新开始的。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a scab splitting in the night and blood coming through again.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「痂在夜里裂开，血又重新渗出来」的画面。

normal.en: Recrudescent contains crude: the wound is raw again.
normal.cn: recrudescent 里有 crude：伤口又变回生的状态。

normal.en: Picture the scab splitting along the same old line.
normal.cn: 想象痂沿着同一条旧缝裂开。

normal.en: Say ree-kroo-DESS-ent; the stress lands on DESS.
normal.cn: 读 ree-kroo-DESS-ent，重音落在 DESS。

normal.en: The word insists that the cause never left, only slept.
normal.cn: 这个词坚持说，病根从未离开，只是睡了。

normal.en: Ask what was left untreated when the first quiet came.
normal.cn: 问第一次平息时有什么没被处理掉。

abstract.en: A recrudescent evil proves that quiet is not a cure.
abstract.cn: 复发的恶事证明，安静不等于治愈。

abstract.en: What returns is usually what was never fully removed.
abstract.cn: 回来的通常是那件从未被彻底清除的东西。

abstract.en: The word is a warning built into a diagnosis.
abstract.cn: 这个词是藏在诊断里的一句警告。

examples.en: A recrudescent fever kept the ward closed for another month.
examples.cn: 复发的热病让病房又多关闭了一个月。

examples.en: Recrudescent violence in the border towns worried the ministry.
examples.cn: 边境城镇重新爆发的暴力让部里感到不安。

examples.en: The doctor watched for recrudescent symptoms after the first week.
examples.cn: 医生在第一周之后密切留意复发的症状。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（再）+ crud（生、未愈）→ 伤口又变回生的状态，重新破开。

root: 拉丁语 recrudescere（重新破开）→ re- + crudus（生的、未愈的）

sensesIntro.en: Two senses follow one reopening: an illness that comes back, and a bad condition in a society that comes back.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项沿着同一次重新裂开：回来的疾病，以及回来的社会恶劣状况。

branches.en: The same illness returning after a quiet spell.
branches.cn: 同一种病在平息一段时间后回来。

branches.en: Old violence returning to the same towns.
branches.cn: 旧暴力回到同一些城镇。

branches.en: A body and a society use the same seam.
branches.cn: 身体与社会裂开的是同一道缝。

branches.en: The medical sense watches the patient.
branches.cn: 医学义盯住的是病人。

branches.en: The political sense watches a region.
branches.cn: 政治义盯住的是地区。

intro.en: The crud- family is about rawness: crude, crudely, crudeness and recrudescent all keep the idea of the unhealed surface.
intro.cn: crud 词族讲的是「生、未愈」：crude、crudely、crudeness 与 recrudescent 都保留未愈合表面的意思。

latinIntro.en: Latin crudus, 'raw', gives crudescere, 'to grow raw', and recrudescere, 'to break raw again'; the re- repeats the opening.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 crudus（生的）生出 crudescere（变生）与 recrudescere（重新裂开变生）；re- 重复那次裂开。

items.meaning: broke out again in the past

definition_zh: 招募；新兵；新成员；恢复（体力）
definition_en: to enlist new members, a newly enlisted person, or, in older use, to restore health or strength
core_image: 训练营门口一张长桌，桌上摊着登记册，年轻人排队写下自己的名字
scene: 训练营门口摆了一张长桌，来报名的人一直排到门外。The sergeant recruited forty men before the rain began.
sceneCN: 这里 recruit 指招募（第 1 个义项：吸收新成员入伍）；句意为雨下来之前，那名军士已经招募了四十个人。

senses.title: To recruit members
senses.definition: to take new people into an army, a company or an organisation
senses.definitionCN: 把新的人收入军队、公司或组织
senses.example: The sergeant recruited forty men before the rain began.
senses.exampleCN: 雨下来之前，那名军士已经招募了四十个人。
senses.why: The first sense is about adding bodies to a group that needs them.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是把人加进某个缺少人手的群体。

senses.title: A new recruit
senses.definition: a person who has just joined a force or a body
senses.definitionCN: 刚刚加入某个队伍或团体的人
senses.example: Every new recruit spends a week on the parade ground.
senses.exampleCN: 每个新兵都要在操场上待一周。
senses.why: The verb becomes a person, and the person is still unfinished.
senses.whyCN: 动词变成了人，而这个人还没有训练成形。

senses.title: To recruit one's strength
senses.definition: in older use, to restore a body's energy after effort or illness
senses.definitionCN: 在旧用法中，指在劳累或疾病之后恢复身体的精力
senses.example: A week in the mountains recruited his strength.
senses.exampleCN: 在山里待了一周，他的体力恢复了。
senses.why: The oldest sense is about growth returning, not people joining.
senses.whyCN: 最老的义项讲的是生长重新回来，而不是人加入。

intro.en: Recruit comes from French recruter, from recrute, 'a fresh growth, a new levy'.
intro.cn: recruit 来自法语 recruter，源头是 recrute（新的生长、新征的兵）。

items.en: Crescere meant to grow.
items.cn: crescere 意为生长。

items.en: The compound meant to grow again.
items.cn: 这个复合词意为重新生长。

items.en: Recrute named a fresh body of troops.
items.cn: recrute 指一支新补充的部队。

items.en: English took the word for a newly enlisted soldier.
items.cn: 英语用它指新入伍的士兵。

items.en: It now covers staff, members and players.
items.cn: 今天它覆盖员工、会员和队员。

note.en: The look-alike group is the rec- verbs that are easily confused with recruit; the near-meaning group separates enlist, conscript, draftee and newcomer.
note.cn: 形近组是容易与 recruit 混淆的 rec 动词；近义组把「使入伍」「征兵」「被征者」「新来者」分开。

entries.definition: to join or cause to join a force.
a person called up for service.
a person who has just arrived.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a long table at the camp gate and a queue of names.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「营门口一张长桌，一串排队写下的名字」的画面。

normal.en: Recruit is about growth: the ranks are made to grow again.
normal.cn: recruit 讲的是生长：队伍被重新长满。

normal.en: Picture the ledger open on the camp table.
normal.cn: 想象营门长桌上摊开的登记册。

normal.en: Say rih-KROOT; it is short, like a shout across a parade ground.
normal.cn: 读 rih-KROOT，短促得像操场上的一声喊。

normal.en: The same word can mean a person and the act of adding people.
normal.cn: 同一个词既能指人，也能指添人的动作。

normal.en: The oldest sense reminds you that bodies must grow back too.
normal.cn: 最老的义项提醒你，身体也需要重新长回来。

abstract.en: To recruit is to buy time with other people's futures.
abstract.cn: 招募就是用别人的未来去买时间。

abstract.en: A recruit is a promise that has not yet been trained.
abstract.cn: 新兵是一个尚未被训练过的承诺。

abstract.en: The word grows out of growth, and still smells of it.
abstract.cn: 这个词从「生长」里长出来，身上还带着那股气息。

examples.en: The sergeant recruited forty men before the rain began.
examples.cn: 雨下来之前，那名军士已经招募了四十个人。

examples.en: Every new recruit spends a week on the parade ground.
examples.cn: 每个新兵都要在操场上待一周。

examples.en: A week in the mountains recruited his strength.
examples.cn: 在山里待了一周，他的体力恢复了。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（再）+ cruit（生长）→ 让队伍重新长出人来。

root: 法语 recrute（新的生长、新征的兵）→ 拉丁语 recrescere（重新生长）

sensesIntro.en: Three senses follow one growth: people added to a group, the person just added, and strength growing back in a body.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项沿着同一次生长：被加进群体的人、刚被加进来的人，以及身体里重新长回的力气。

branches.en: The act of adding people to a group.
branches.cn: 把新人加进群体的动作。

branches.en: The person who has just been added.
branches.cn: 刚被加进来的那个人。

branches.en: Strength growing back inside a body.
branches.cn: 身体里重新长回的力气。

branches.en: The act and its object share one word.
branches.cn: 动作与它的对象共用一个词。

branches.en: Both are unfinished and still growing.
branches.cn: 两者都未完成，都还在生长。

intro.en: The recruit- family is about adding people: recruitment, recruiter and recruitable all keep the camp-ledger image.
intro.cn: recruit 词族讲的是添人：recruitment、recruiter、recruitable 都保留营中登记册的意象。

latinIntro.en: French recrute goes back to Latin crescere, 'to grow'; the re- says the body of troops must grow again.
latinIntro.cn: 法语的 recrute 可追到拉丁语 crescere（生长）；re- 表示这支队伍必须重新长起来。

items.meaning: a fresh growth, a new soldier

definition_zh: 矩形；长方形；长方形的一片区域
definition_en: a four-sided figure with four right angles, or a rectangular patch of something
core_image: 黑板上一块被粉笔框出的方形，正好把地图的一角圈在里面
scene: 他用粉笔在地图上把两座城镇框进同一个方形里。He drew a rectangle around the two towns on the map.
sceneCN: 这里 rectangle 指矩形（第 1 个义项：四个直角的四边形）；句意为他用粉笔在地图上画了一个矩形，把两座城镇圈在里面。

pos.zh: 矩形；长方形；长方形区域

senses.title: A geometric rectangle
senses.definition: a plane figure with four straight sides and four right angles
senses.definitionCN: 有四条直边和四个直角的平面图形
senses.example: He drew a rectangle around the two towns on the map.
senses.exampleCN: 他在地图上画了一个矩形，把两座城镇框在里面。
senses.why: The first sense is exact: geometry fixes the angles and the sides.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是精确的：几何学规定了角与边。

senses.title: A rectangle of light
senses.definition: a rectangular patch or area of a surface, light or colour
senses.definitionCN: 表面、光或颜色上呈长方形的一片
senses.example: A rectangle of sunlight lay across the floor.
senses.exampleCN: 一片长方形的阳光横铺在地板上。
senses.why: No angle is measured here; the eye simply sees a long block of light.
senses.whyCN: 这里并不测量角度，眼睛只是看到一块长条形的光。

intro.en: Rectangle comes from Latin rectangulus, 'having right angles', from rectus, 'straight', and angulus, 'angle'.
intro.cn: rectangle 来自拉丁语 rectangulus（有直角的），由 rectus（直的）与 angulus（角）构成。

items.en: Rectus meant straight or right.
items.cn: rectus 意为直的、正的。

items.en: Angulus meant a corner or an angle.
items.cn: angulus 意为角、拐角。

items.en: The compound named a figure with right angles.
items.cn: 这个复合词指有直角的图形。

items.en: French shortened the word into rectangle.
items.cn: 法语把它缩短成 rectangle。

items.en: English kept it for the four-sided figure.
items.cn: 英语用它指这种四边形。

note.en: The look-alike group is the rect- family, which shares the root of straightness; the near-meaning group separates square, oblong, quadrilateral and parallelogram.
note.cn: 形近组是 rect 词族，共享「直」的词根；近义组把「正方形」「长椭圆形／长方形」「四边形」「平行四边形」分开。

entries.definition: the lower end of the bowel.
a rectangle longer than it is wide.
a four-sided figure with parallel opposite sides.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a chalk box drawn on a map around two towns.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「在地图上用粉笔框住两座城镇的方框」的画面。

normal.en: Rectangle is rect plus angle: four right angles make the name.
normal.cn: rectangle 是 rect 加 angle：四个直角造出了这个名字。

normal.en: Picture the chalk line closing on itself.
normal.cn: 想象那道粉笔线自己合拢起来。

normal.en: Say REK-tang-gl; the hard g closes the word.
normal.cn: 读 REK-tang-gl，末尾的硬 g 收住词音。

normal.en: A square is only the strictest rectangle.
normal.cn: 正方形只是最严格的那个矩形。

normal.en: The word can describe a figure, a field or a patch of light.
normal.cn: 这个词能描述图形、田地，也能描述一片光。

abstract.en: A rectangle is agreement made visible: two pairs of sides consent to be parallel.
abstract.cn: 矩形是看得见的约定：两对边同意保持平行。

abstract.en: The shape is the simplest way to hold an area still.
abstract.cn: 这个形状是把一片面积固定下来的最简单办法。

abstract.en: Chalk rectangles are how people make the world countable.
abstract.cn: 粉笔画的矩形是人把世界变得可数的方式。

examples.en: He drew a rectangle around the two towns on the map.
examples.cn: 他在地图上画了一个矩形，把两座城镇框在里面。

examples.en: A rectangle of sunlight lay across the floor.
examples.cn: 一片长方形的阳光横铺在地板上。

examples.en: The garden was laid out as a long rectangle.
examples.cn: 那座园子被布置成一个窄长的矩形。

dict_mnemonic.text: rect（直）+ angle（角）→ 四个角都是直角的四边形。

root: 拉丁语 rectangulus（有直角的）→ rectus（直的）+ angulus（角）

sensesIntro.en: Two senses: the exact figure of geometry, and any long block the eye picks out on a surface.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项：几何学里那个精确的图形，以及眼睛在表面上看出的任何一块长条。

core.en: A CHALK BOX CLOSED ON ITSELF

branches.en: The measured figure with four right angles.
branches.cn: 四个直角、可以测量的图形。

branches.en: A block of light or colour on a surface.
branches.cn: 表面上的一块光或一块颜色。

branches.en: One is proved, the other merely seen.
branches.cn: 一个被证明，一个只是被看见。

branches.en: Geometry keeps the sides straight.
branches.cn: 几何学要求边是直的。

branches.en: The eye keeps only the outline.
branches.cn: 眼睛只保留轮廓。

intro.en: The rect- family is about straightness: rectus gives rectangle, rectify, rectitude and rectilinear the same spine.
intro.cn: rect 词族讲的是「直」：rectus 给 rectangle、rectify、rectitude、rectilinear 同一根脊梁。

latinIntro.en: Latin rectus, 'straight', joins angulus, 'angle', to make rectangulus; the figure is literally a right-angled thing.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rectus（直）与 angulus（角）合成 rectangulus；这个图形字面上就是「有直角的東西」。

definition_zh: 矩形的；长方形的；直角的
definition_en: shaped like a rectangle, or meeting at right angles
core_image: 砖窑里每一块砖都被切成长方形，码起来时边角严丝合缝
scene: 砖窑里的砖都被切成长方形，砌墙时边角对得整整齐齐。The bricks were cut rectangular so that the wall would not wobble.
sceneCN: 这里 rectangular 指矩形的、长方形的（第 1 个义项：形状像矩形）；句意为砖被切成长方形，砌起来墙才不会晃。

pos.zh: 矩形的；长方形的；直角的

senses.title: A rectangular table
senses.definition: having the shape of a rectangle, with four straight sides and right angles
senses.definitionCN: 形状像矩形，有四条直边和直角
senses.example: The bricks were cut rectangular so that the wall would not wobble.
senses.exampleCN: 砖被切成长方形，砌起来墙才不会晃。
senses.why: The first sense is about outline: the object looks like a rectangle.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项讲的是外形：这件东西看起来像一个矩形。

senses.title: Rectangular coordinates
senses.definition: of lines or axes, meeting at right angles
senses.definitionCN: 指线或坐标轴以直角相交
senses.example: The plan uses rectangular coordinates for every corner.
senses.exampleCN: 这张图对每个角点都采用直角坐标。
senses.why: Here the word is about the angle, not the outline.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项讲的是角，而不是外形。

intro.en: Rectangular comes from Medieval Latin rectangularis, built on rectangulus, 'having right angles'.
intro.cn: rectangular 来自中世纪拉丁语 rectangularis，构词基础是 rectangulus（有直角的）。

items.en: Rectus meant straight or right.
items.cn: rectus 意为直的、正的。

items.en: Angulus meant a corner or an angle.
items.cn: angulus 意为角、拐角。

items.en: The compound meant right-angled.
items.cn: 这个复合词意为有直角的。

items.en: Medieval Latin added the adjective ending.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语加上了形容词词尾。

items.en: English uses it for shapes and for axes.
items.cn: 英语用它说形状，也说坐标轴。

note.en: The look-alike group is the rect- family; the near-meaning group separates oblong, quadrangular, right-angled and boxy.
note.cn: 形近组是 rect 词族；近义组把「长方形的」「四角的」「直角的」「方盒状的」分开。

entries.definition: a figure with four right angles.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a brick wall where every brick is the same long block.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「每一块砖都是同一个长条块」的砖墙画面。

normal.en: Rectangular is rectangle plus the adjective ending.
normal.cn: rectangular 就是 rectangle 加上形容词词尾。

normal.en: Picture the corner where two walls meet at a perfect right angle.
normal.cn: 想象两面墙以完美的直角相交的那个角。

normal.en: Say rek-TANG-gyuh-ler; TANG carries the stress.
normal.cn: 读 rek-TANG-gyuh-ler，重音在 TANG。

normal.en: A brick is rectangular; a heap of bricks is not.
normal.cn: 一块砖是矩形的，一堆砖不是。

normal.en: The word also describes axes that cross at ninety degrees.
normal.cn: 这个词也描述以九十度相交的坐标轴。

abstract.en: Rectangular describes a promise that the corners will behave.
abstract.cn: rectangular 描述的是一种「角会守规矩」的承诺。

abstract.en: The adjective turns a shape into a rule for building.
abstract.cn: 这个形容词把一种形状变成了建造的规则。

abstract.en: Ordinary walls are rectangles that forgot they were geometry.
abstract.cn: 寻常的墙是忘了自己是几何的矩形。

examples.en: The bricks were cut rectangular so that the wall would not wobble.
examples.cn: 砖被切成长方形，砌起来墙才不会晃。

examples.en: A rectangular table stood against the far wall.
examples.cn: 一张长方形的桌子靠在对面的墙边。

examples.en: The plan uses rectangular coordinates for every corner.
examples.cn: 这张图对每个角点都采用直角坐标。

dict_mnemonic.text: rect（直）+ angular（有角的）→ 四个角都是直角的。

root: 中世纪拉丁语 rectangularis → rectus（直的）+ angulus（角）

sensesIntro.en: Two senses: an object whose outline is a rectangle, and lines that meet at right angles.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项：外形是矩形的物体，以及以直角相交的线。

core.en: A BRICK THAT KEEPS ITS CORNERS

chain: THE AXES MEET AT RIGHT ANGLES

branches.en: An outline that looks like a rectangle.
branches.cn: 看起来像矩形的外形。

branches.en: Axes or lines crossing at right angles.
branches.cn: 以直角相交的坐标轴或直线。

branches.en: The shape and the angle share one root.
branches.cn: 形状与角共享同一个词根。

branches.en: Bricks, tables and fields take the shape.
branches.cn: 砖、桌子、田地取这种形状。

branches.en: Surveying and graphs take the angle.
branches.cn: 测量与图表取这个角。

intro.en: The rect- family is about straightness: rectangle, rectilinear, rectify and rectitude all stand on rectus.
intro.cn: rect 词族讲的是「直」：rectangle、rectilinear、rectify、rectitude 都立在 rectus 上。

latinIntro.en: Latin rectus and angulus combine into rectangulus; the adjective ending -aris turns the shape into a description.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rectus 与 angulus 合成 rectangulus；形容词词尾 -aris 把形状变成一种描述。

items.example: The beds were laid out rectangularly.

definition_zh: 纠正；校正；整流；精馏
definition_en: to set right, to adjust precisely, or to convert current and purify a liquid
core_image: 仪表上的指针偏左一格，技师拧动旋钮，把它一点点拨回零位
scene: 仪器上的读数总是偏左一格，技师在第二次测量之前把它调回了零位。The technician rectified the gauge before the second reading.
sceneCN: 这里 rectify 指校正（第 2 个义项：把仪器或读数调到正确位置）；句意为技师在第二次测量之前校正了仪表。

senses.title: To rectify an error
senses.definition: to correct something wrong or unjust
senses.definitionCN: 把错误或不公正的地方改正过来
senses.example: The committee moved to rectify the error in the pay scale.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会着手纠正薪酬表中的那处错误。
senses.why: The first sense is moral or administrative: something was wrong and is made right.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是道德或行政层面的：有错，被改正。

senses.title: To rectify an instrument
senses.definition: to adjust a device or a reading until it is accurate
senses.definitionCN: 把装置或读数调到准确为止
senses.example: The technician rectified the gauge before the second reading.
senses.exampleCN: 技师在第二次测量之前校正了仪表。
senses.why: Here the fault is mechanical, and the fix is a small adjustment.
senses.whyCN: 这里的毛病是机械的，修法是细微的调整。

senses.title: To rectify a current
senses.definition: to change alternating current into direct current
senses.definitionCN: 把交流电变成直流电
senses.example: A bridge of diodes rectifies the current.
senses.exampleCN: 一组二极管把电流整流。
senses.why: Electrical engineering borrowed the word for a one-way gate.
senses.whyCN: 电工学借这个词来指一道单向的门。

senses.title: To rectify a liquid
senses.definition: to purify a liquid by repeated distillation
senses.definitionCN: 通过反复蒸馏提纯一种液体
senses.example: The laboratory rectified the alcohol three times.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室把酒精精馏了三次。
senses.why: Chemistry uses the word for making a substance purer.
senses.whyCN: 化学用这个词指把物质提得更纯。

intro.en: Rectify comes from Latin rectificare, 'to make right', from rectus, 'right', and facere, 'to make'.
intro.cn: rectify 来自拉丁语 rectificare（使正确），由 rectus（正的）与 facere（做）构成。

items.en: Rectus meant straight or right.
items.cn: rectus 意为直的、正的。

items.en: Facere meant to make or do.
items.cn: facere 意为做、造。

items.en: The compound meant to make a thing right.
items.cn: 这个复合词意为把东西弄正。

items.en: English used it for correcting errors and abuses.
items.cn: 英语用它指纠正错误与弊端。

items.en: Electricity and chemistry later gave it new tasks.
items.cn: 电学与化学后来给了它新的任务。

note.en: The look-alike group is the rect- family; the near-meaning group separates correct, adjust, amend and purify.
note.cn: 形近组是 rect 词族；近义组把「改正」「调整」「修订」「提纯」分开。

entries.definition: to change a text or rule for the better.
entries.definitionCN: 为改进而修改文本或规则。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a needle off zero and a hand turning it back.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「指针偏离零位，一只手把它拨回来」的画面。

normal.en: Rectify is rect plus fy: to make a thing right.
normal.cn: rectify 是 rect 加 fy：把东西弄正。

normal.en: Picture the needle stopping exactly on the zero mark.
normal.cn: 想象指针正好停在零刻度上。

normal.en: Say REK-tih-fy; the stress sits on REK.
normal.cn: 读 REK-tih-fy，重音落在 REK。

normal.en: The word fixes errors, gauges, currents and liquids.
normal.cn: 这个词修错误、修仪表、修电流、修液体。

normal.en: Ask what standard the thing is being brought back to.
normal.cn: 问这件东西正被拨回到哪个标准。

abstract.en: To rectify is to admit that a standard exists outside the mistake.
abstract.cn: 纠正就是承认错误之外还有一个标准。

abstract.en: A rectifier is a moral idea built into a circuit.
abstract.cn: 整流器是一个被装进电路的道德观念。

abstract.en: Purity, accuracy and justice share one verb by accident of history.
abstract.cn: 提纯、准确与公正因历史的偶然共享一个动词。

examples.en: The committee moved to rectify the error in the pay scale.
examples.cn: 委员会着手纠正薪酬表中的那处错误。

examples.en: The technician rectified the gauge before the second reading.
examples.cn: 技师在第二次测量之前校正了仪表。

examples.en: A bridge of diodes rectifies the current.
examples.cn: 一组二极管把电流整流。

dict_mnemonic.text: rect（正、直）+ fy（使）→ 把歪的东西弄正。

root: 拉丁语 rectificare（使正确）→ rectus（正的）+ facere（做）

sensesIntro.en: Four senses make four things right: an error, a device, a current and a liquid.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项把四样东西弄正：一处错误、一台装置、一股电流、一种液体。

core.en: THE NEEDLE BROUGHT BACK TO ZERO

branches.en: An error or injustice corrected.
branches.cn: 被纠正的错误或不公。

branches.en: A device adjusted to accuracy.
branches.cn: 被调到准确的装置。

branches.en: Alternating current turned one way.
branches.cn: 被变成单向的交流电。

branches.en: A liquid made purer by distillation.
branches.cn: 被蒸馏得更纯的液体。

branches.en: Moral repair and chemical purity share the verb.
branches.cn: 道德修补与化学提纯共用这个动词。

intro.en: The word joins rectus, 'right', and facere, 'to make': rectify is literally to make right, and its family keeps that shape.
intro.cn: 这个词把 rectus（正）与 facere（做）连在一起：rectify 字面上就是「使正」，它的词族保持这个形状。

latinIntro.en: Latin rectificare passes into English through French; the same facere gives fact, effect and manufacture.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rectificare 经由法语进入英语；同一个 facere 还给出 fact、effect、manufacture。

definition_zh: 正直；操守端正；（判断的）正确
definition_en: moral uprightness, or the quality of being correct in judgment
core_image: 一条拉得笔直的墨线，从纸的一端一直画到另一端，中间没有弯
scene: 他一辈子没有收过一笔不该收的钱，连对手也承认这一点。Even his rivals spoke of the old judge's rectitude.
sceneCN: 这里 rectitude 指正直、操守端正（第 1 个义项：道德上的端正）；句意为连对手也承认这位老法官的正直。

derivatives.zh: 道德端正的；一本正经的

senses.title: Moral rectitude
senses.definition: the quality of being morally upright and honest
senses.definitionCN: 在道德上端正、诚实无欺的品质
senses.example: Even his rivals spoke of the old judge's rectitude.
senses.exampleCN: 连对手也承认这位老法官的正直。
senses.why: The first sense is about character: the line inside a person does not bend.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项讲的是品格：人心里那条线不弯。

senses.title: Rectitude of judgment
senses.definition: the quality of being correct or exact in judgement or method
senses.definitionCN: 在判断或方法上正确、准确的品质
senses.example: The essay was praised for the rectitude of its judgment.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章因判断的准确而受到称赞。
senses.why: Here the straightness is intellectual, not moral.
senses.whyCN: 这里的「直」是智性的，而不是道德的。

intro.en: Rectitude comes from Latin rectitudo, 'straightness', from rectus, 'straight or right'.
intro.cn: rectitude 来自拉丁语 rectitudo（笔直），源于 rectus（直、正）。

items.en: Rectus meant straight or right.
items.cn: rectus 意为直的、正的。

items.en: Rectitudo named the quality of being straight.
items.cn: rectitudo 指「直」这一性质。

items.en: A straight line became an image of an honest life.
items.cn: 一条直线成了诚实生活的意象。

items.en: English took the word for uprightness of character.
items.cn: 英语用它指品格的端正。

items.en: Today it is formal and slightly old-fashioned.
items.cn: 今天它正式而略带古意。

note.en: The look-alike group is the rect- family; the near-meaning group separates integrity, uprightness, probity and honesty.
note.cn: 形近组是 rect 词族；近义组把「完整人格」「端正」「廉洁」「诚实」分开。

entries.definition: wholeness of character that resists corruption.
entries.definitionCN: 不为腐蚀所动的人格完整。

entries.definition: the state of being morally straight.

entries.definitionCN: 公共生活中经得起考验的诚实。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a ruled line drawn from edge to edge without a bend.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一条从纸边拉到纸边、中间不弯的墨线」的画面。

normal.en: Rectitude is the noun of rectus, straightness itself.
normal.cn: rectitude 是 rectus 的名词形式，就是「直」本身。

normal.en: Picture the ruler laid down and the line following it exactly.
normal.cn: 想象尺子压住纸，线完全贴着它走。

normal.en: Say REK-tih-tyood; the last syllable is long.
normal.cn: 读 REK-tih-tyood，最后一个音节是长音。

normal.en: The word prefers courts, biographies and obituaries.
normal.cn: 这个词偏爱法庭、传记与讣告。

normal.en: Ask where the line would bend if no one were watching.
normal.cn: 问如果没人看着，这条线会在哪里弯。

abstract.en: Rectitude is a straight line that has learned to feel shame.
abstract.cn: 正直是一条学会了羞耻的直线。

abstract.en: Character is geometry that keeps its shape under pressure.
abstract.cn: 品格是在压力下仍保持形状的几何。

abstract.en: The word is old because the virtue is older than the word.
abstract.cn: 这个词老，因为这种德性比词更老。

examples.en: Even his rivals spoke of the old judge's rectitude.
examples.cn: 连对手也承认这位老法官的正直。

examples.en: The essay was praised for the rectitude of its judgment.
examples.cn: 这篇文章因判断的准确而受到称赞。

examples.en: She was known for a rectitude that made flattery useless.
examples.cn: 她以正直著称，奉承对她毫无用处。

dict_mnemonic.text: rect（直）+ itude（性质）→ 一条不弯的直线，用作人的品格。

root: 拉丁语 rectitudo（笔直）→ rectus（直、正）

sensesIntro.en: Two senses keep the same straight line: one in a person's character, one in a person's judgement.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项守着同一条直线：一条在人的品格里，一条在人的判断里。

core.en: A LINE THAT DOES NOT BEND

branches.en: The moral line held inside a person.
branches.cn: 守在人心里那条道德的线。

branches.en: The intellectual line held in judgement.
branches.cn: 守判断里那条智性的线。

branches.en: Both are straightness, one of will and one of mind.
branches.cn: 两者都是直，一个是意志的，一个是心智的。

branches.en: Character is what the neighbours cannot see.
branches.cn: 品格是邻居看不见的东西。

branches.en: Judgement is what the reader can check.
branches.cn: 判断是读者可以核对的东西。

intro.en: The rect- family is about straightness: rectitude, rectify and rectilinear all stand on the same Latin line.
intro.cn: rect 词族讲的是「直」：rectitude、rectify、rectilinear 都立在同一根拉丁线上。

latinIntro.en: Latin rectus, 'straight', gives rectitudo, 'straightness'; English turned the physical line into a word about character.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rectus（直）给出 rectitudo（笔直）；英语把这条实体的线变成了说品格的词。

items.exampleCN: 一个直线式的街道规划。

definition_zh: 躺着的；斜靠的；卧式的；（植物）匍匐的
definition_en: lying down or leaning back, of a seat or bicycle, or of a plant growing along the ground
core_image: 午后一个人半躺在低矮的躺椅上，膝盖抬得比胸口还高
scene: 午后他把自己斜靠在一张低矮的躺椅上，膝盖抬得比胸口还高。He spent the afternoon recumbent in a low chair, reading with his knees above his chest.
sceneCN: 这里 recumbent 指躺着的、斜靠的（第 1 个义项：人或姿态呈躺卧状态）；句意为午后他半躺在低矮的躺椅上读书，膝盖抬得比胸口还高。

senses.title: A recumbent posture
senses.definition: of a person or an animal, lying down or leaning far back
senses.definitionCN: 指人或动物躺下或大大地向后靠
senses.example: He spent the afternoon recumbent in a low chair, reading with his knees above his chest.
senses.exampleCN: 午后他半躺在低矮的躺椅上读书，膝盖抬得比胸口还高。
senses.why: The first sense is about a body at rest, its weight taken off the feet.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项讲的是休息中的身体，重量从脚上卸下来。

senses.title: A recumbent bicycle
senses.definition: of a machine or seat, built so that the user lies back
senses.definitionCN: 指机器或座椅被设计成让人向后躺的
senses.example: A recumbent bicycle puts the rider's back against a reclined seat.
senses.exampleCN: 卧式自行车让骑车人的背靠在一个后倾的座位上。
senses.why: Here the word describes a design, not a moment of rest.
senses.whyCN: 这里描述的是设计，而不是休息的瞬间。

senses.title: Recumbent stems
senses.definition: of a plant, growing along or close to the ground
senses.definitionCN: 指植物沿地面或贴近地面生长
senses.example: The recumbent stems of the vine root wherever they touch soil.
senses.exampleCN: 这种藤匍匐的茎碰到土壤就在那里生根。
senses.why: Botany borrows the lying-down image for growth.
senses.whyCN: 植物学借用了「躺下」的意象来描述生长。

intro.en: Recumbent comes from Latin recumbere, 'to lie back', from re- and cumbere, 'to lie'.
intro.cn: recumbent 来自拉丁语 recumbere（向后躺），由 re- 加 cumbere（躺）构成。

items.en: Cumbere meant to lie down.
items.cn: cumbere 意为躺下。

items.en: The compound meant to lie back or recline.
items.cn: 这个复合词意为向后躺、斜倚。

items.en: The participle described a reclining posture.
items.cn: 这个分词描述斜倚的姿势。

items.en: English used it for statues and for patients.
items.cn: 英语用它说卧像，也说病人。

items.en: Bicycles and botany later extended the word.
items.cn: 自行车与植物学后来扩展了这个词。

note.en: The look-alike group is the cumb- family; the near-meaning group separates reclining, supine, prone and prostrate.
note.cn: 形近组是 cumb 词族；近义组把「斜倚的」「仰卧的」「俯卧的」「俯伏的」分开。

entries.definition: lying on, hence holding an office.
entries.definitionCN: 压在上面，因而指在任的。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a low chair and a body whose knees are higher than its chest.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一张低矮的椅子，膝盖比胸口还高的身体」的画面。

normal.en: Recumbent is re plus cumbere, to lie back.
normal.cn: recumbent 是 re 加 cumbere：向后躺。

normal.en: Picture the shoulders going down and the knees going up.
normal.cn: 想象肩膀往下沉，膝盖往上抬。

normal.en: Say rih-KUM-bent; KUM carries the stress.
normal.cn: 读 rih-KUM-bent，重音在 KUM。

normal.en: A bed, a bicycle and a vine stem can all be recumbent.
normal.cn: 床、自行车和藤茎都可以是 recumbent。

normal.en: The word describes where the weight rests.
normal.cn: 这个词描述重量落在哪里。

abstract.en: Recumbent is the body voting to stop standing.
abstract.cn: 躺卧是身体投票决定不再站立。

abstract.en: Every reclining design is an argument about gravity.
abstract.cn: 每一种卧式设计都是关于重力的一场论证。

abstract.en: Plants lie down in order to travel, people in order to rest.
abstract.cn: 植物躺下是为了前进，人躺下是为了休息。

examples.en: He spent the afternoon recumbent in a low chair, reading with his knees above his chest.
examples.cn: 午后他半躺在低矮的躺椅上读书，膝盖抬得比胸口还高。

examples.en: A recumbent bicycle puts the rider's back against a reclined seat.
examples.cn: 卧式自行车让骑车人的背靠在一个后倾的座位上。

examples.en: The recumbent stems of the vine root wherever they touch soil.
examples.cn: 这种藤匍匐的茎碰到土壤就在那里生根。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（向后）+ cumb（躺）+ ent（形容词）→ 向后躺下的。

root: 拉丁语 recumbere（向后躺）→ re- + cumbere（躺）

sensesIntro.en: Three senses keep one reclining body: a resting person, a designed seat, and a plant that grows flat.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项守着同一个后躺的身体：休息的人、被设计成后躺的座椅，以及贴着地生长的植物。

branches.en: A person lying or leaning far back.
branches.cn: 躺下或大大后倚的人。

branches.en: A seat or cycle built for that posture.
branches.cn: 为这种姿势设计的座椅或车。

branches.en: A plant growing along the ground.
branches.cn: 沿地面生长的植物。

branches.en: The posture and its furniture share one word.
branches.cn: 姿势与承载它的器物共用一个词。

branches.en: Both lie down by design, not by fatigue.
branches.cn: 两者都因设计而躺下，不因疲倦。

intro.en: The cumb- family is about lying: recumbent, procumbent and incumbent all describe what lies where, and succumb means to lie under.
intro.cn: cumb 词族讲的是「躺」：recumbent、procumbent、incumbent 都在描述什么躺在何处，succumb 则是躺到下面去。

latinIntro.en: Latin cumbere, 'to lie', gives recumbere, 'to lie back'; the same root yields incumbent and succumb.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cumbere（躺）给出 recumbere（向后躺）；同一词根还生出 incumbent 与 succumb。

items.meaning: to lie under, hence to yield

definition_zh: 再次发生；重现；重提；（小数）循环
definition_en: to happen again, to come back to mind or to a subject, or of a decimal, to repeat endlessly
core_image: 入冬之后，同一间候诊室里又坐满同样咳嗽的人
scene: 每年入冬，镇上那家诊所的候诊室里又坐满同样咳嗽的人。The same cough recurs in the clinic every winter.
sceneCN: 这里 recur 指再次发生（第 1 个义项：同一件事在一段时间之后重来）；句意为每年入冬，那家诊所里同样的咳嗽又出现。

pos.zh: 再次发生；重现；重提；循环

senses.title: A problem that recurs
senses.definition: of an event or condition, to happen again after an interval
senses.definitionCN: 指事件或状况隔一段时间再次发生
senses.example: The same cough recurs in the clinic every winter.
senses.exampleCN: 每年冬天，同样的咳嗽都会在那家诊所里出现。
senses.why: The first sense is about time: the same thing returns on a schedule or a cycle.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项讲的是时间：同一件事按周期回来。

senses.title: A memory that recurs
senses.definition: of a thought, image or symptom, to come back to the mind or body
senses.definitionCN: 指念头、画面或症状重新回到心里或身上
senses.example: The same image recurred to her at the sound of a door closing.
senses.exampleCN: 门一响，同一个画面又回到她脑海里。
senses.why: Here the return is inward, inside one person.
senses.whyCN: 这里的返回是向内的，发生在一个人心里。

senses.title: To recur to a subject
senses.definition: to return in speech or writing to an earlier point
senses.definitionCN: 在说话或写作中回到先前的一点
senses.example: Let us recur to the question of cost before we go on.
senses.exampleCN: 在继续之前，让我们回到成本这个问题。
senses.why: The verb can mean a speaker going back, not an event.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词可以指说话人往回走，而不是事件重来。

senses.title: A decimal that recurs
senses.definition: of a decimal, to repeat the same digits without end
senses.definitionCN: 指小数位上的同一串数字无限重复
senses.example: The decimal recurs after the third digit.
senses.exampleCN: 这个小数在第三位之后开始循环。
senses.why: Mathematics uses the word for a pattern that never stops.
senses.whyCN: 数学用这个词指一种永不停止的模式。

intro.en: Recur comes from Latin recurrere, 'to run back', from re- and currere, 'to run'.
intro.cn: recur 来自拉丁语 recurrere（跑回来），由 re- 加 currere（跑）构成。

items.en: Currere meant to run.
items.cn: currere 意为跑。

items.en: The compound meant to run back or return.
items.cn: 这个复合词意为跑回来、返回。

items.en: English used it for events that come round again.
items.cn: 英语用它指再度到来事件。

items.en: Doctors used it for symptoms that return.
items.cn: 医生用它说回来的症状。

items.en: Arithmetic gave it the sense of a repeating decimal.
items.cn: 算术给了它循环小数的意义。

note.en: The look-alike group is the recur- family and its near spellings; the near-meaning group separates repeat, reappear, persist and return.
note.cn: 形近组是 recur 词族及其相近拼写；近义组把「重复」「再现」「持续」「返回」分开。

entries.definition: a return of the same event.
to do or say the same thing again.
to come back to a place or state.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of the same coughing patients filling the same waiting room each winter.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「每年冬天同一间候诊室又坐满同样咳嗽的人」的画面。

normal.en: Recur is re plus cur, to run back: time runs the same way again.
normal.cn: recur 是 re 加 cur，跑回来：时间又按原路跑一遍。

normal.en: Picture the calendar page turning to the same month.
normal.cn: 想象日历又翻到同一个月份。

normal.en: Say rih-KUR; the vowel is the same as in occur.
normal.cn: 读 rih-KUR，元音与 occur 相同。

normal.en: The word needs an interval: recurrence is not mere repetition.
normal.cn: 这个词需要一段间隔：复发不是单纯的重复。

normal.en: Ask how long the gap is, not only that it happens again.
normal.cn: 问间隔有多长，而不只是会不会再来。

abstract.en: To recur is to prove that time has a fold in it.
abstract.cn: 复发就是证明时间里有一道褶。

abstract.en: A recurring problem is a problem that was never quite closed.
abstract.cn: 反复出现的问题，是从未被真正结清的问题。

abstract.en: The word links calendars, memories and decimals in one motion.
abstract.cn: 这个词把日历、记忆与小数连在同一种运动里。

examples.en: The same cough recurs in the clinic every winter.
examples.cn: 每年冬天，同样的咳嗽都会在那家诊所里出现。

examples.en: The same image recurred to her at the sound of a door closing.
examples.cn: 门一响，同一个画面又回到她脑海里。

examples.en: Let us recur to the question of cost before we go on.
examples.cn: 在继续之前，让我们回到成本这个问题。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）+ cur（跑）→ 时间又跑回同一个地方。

root: 拉丁语 recurrere（跑回来）→ re- + currere（跑）

sensesIntro.en: Four senses return in four ways: an event in time, an image in the mind, a speaker to a topic, and digits in a decimal.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项以四种方式返回：时间里的事件、心里的画面、说话人回到话题，以及小数里的数字。

branches.en: An event returning after an interval.
branches.cn: 隔一段时间回来的事件。

branches.en: An image returning inside one mind.
branches.cn: 在一个人心里回来的画面。

branches.en: A speaker returning to an earlier point.
branches.cn: 说话人回到先前的一点。

branches.en: Digits returning without end.
branches.cn: 无尽重复的数字。

branches.en: Both are patterns that refuse to stop.
branches.cn: 两者都是不肯停止的模式。

intro.en: The recur- family is about running back: recur, recurrence, recurrent and recursion all share the Latin verb of running.
intro.cn: recur 词族讲的是跑回来：recur、recurrence、recurrent、recursion 共享那个表示「跑」的拉丁动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin currere, 'to run', yields recurrere, 'to run back'; English shortened it to recur and kept the sense of return.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 currere（跑）生出 recurrere（跑回来）；英语简化为 recur，保留了「返回」的意思。

items.meaning: to run back, to happen again
a return of the same event

definition_zh: 赎回；弥补；兑换；救赎；履行（诺言）
definition_en: to buy back, to make good, to exchange a token, to save from sin, or to carry out a promise
core_image: 当铺柜台上，一块旧怀表被推回主人手里，旁边压着刚付清的当票
scene: 当铺里那块怀表被主人用多出一成的钱取了回来。He redeemed the watch from the pawnshop before the month was out.
sceneCN: 这里 redeem 指赎回（第 1 个义项：付钱把抵押出去的东西取回）；句意为月底之前，他用钱把那块表从当铺赎回。

senses.title: To redeem a pledge
senses.definition: to buy back something given as security for a loan
senses.definitionCN: 付钱取回为借款而抵押出去的东西
senses.example: He redeemed the watch from the pawnshop before the month was out.
senses.exampleCN: 月底之前，他把那块表从当铺赎回。
senses.why: The first sense is the oldest: money is paid and the object comes home.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项最古老：钱付出去，东西回家。

senses.title: To redeem a fault
senses.definition: to make good a failure or an offence by some counterweight
senses.definitionCN: 用某种补偿把失败或过失抵消掉
senses.example: One honest report redeemed a year of careless work.
senses.exampleCN: 一份诚实的报告弥补了一整年的粗心工作。
senses.why: Here the thing bought back is not an object but a reputation.
senses.whyCN: 这里赎回来的不是物件，而是名声。

senses.title: To redeem a coupon
senses.definition: to exchange a token, voucher or points for goods or value
senses.definitionCN: 用票券、代金券或积分换取商品或价值
senses.example: The voucher can be redeemed at any branch.
senses.exampleCN: 这张代金券可在任何分店兑换。
senses.why: Commerce keeps the paying image inside a paper token.
senses.whyCN: 商业把「付钱」的意象留在一张纸券里。

senses.title: To redeem a sinner
senses.definition: in religious use, to save a person from sin or its penalty
senses.definitionCN: 在宗教用法中，指把人从罪或其惩罚中救出来
senses.example: The preacher said no one was beyond being redeemed.
senses.exampleCN: 牧师说没有人是救不回来的。
senses.why: Theology turns the buying back into a rescue of the soul.
senses.whyCN: 神学把「赎回」变成对灵魂的营救。

senses.title: To redeem a promise
senses.definition: to carry out a pledge or fulfil an undertaking
senses.definitionCN: 兑现一项保证或完成一项承诺
senses.example: He redeemed his promise with a single phone call.
senses.exampleCN: 他用一通电话履行了自己的诺言。
senses.why: A promise is treated as a debt that must be paid.
senses.whyCN: 诺言被当作一笔必须偿还的债。

intro.en: Redeem comes from Latin redimere, 'to buy back', from re- and emere, 'to buy'.
intro.cn: redeem 来自拉丁语 redimere（买回来），由 re- 加 emere（买）构成。

items.en: Emere meant to buy.
items.cn: emere 意为买。

items.en: The compound meant to buy a thing back.
items.cn: 这个复合词意为把东西买回来。

items.en: English used it for buying back pledges.
items.cn: 英语用它指赎回抵押物。

items.en: The church made it the word for salvation.
items.cn: 教会让它成为「救赎」的词。

items.en: Shops now use it for coupons and points.
items.cn: 商店现在用它说优惠券与积分。

note.en: The look-alike group is the redeem- family; the near-meaning group separates ransom, compensate, honour and reclaim.
note.cn: 形近组是 redeem 词族；近义组把「赎金赎回」「补偿」「兑现（承诺）」「讨回」分开。

entries.definition: able to be bought back or exchanged.
one who buys back or saves.
serving to save or make good.
to pay for the release of a captive.
to make up for a loss.
to keep a promise or an agreement.
to demand the return of one's own.
entries.definitionCN: 要求归还原属自己的东西。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a pawn ticket and a watch sliding back across the counter.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一张当票，一块表从柜台那边滑回来」的画面。

normal.en: Redeem is re plus emere, to buy back.
normal.cn: redeem 是 re 加 emere：买回来。

normal.en: Picture the watch passing back across the counter.
normal.cn: 想象那块表从柜台那头滑了回来。

normal.en: Say rih-DEEM; the long vowel is the price paid.
normal.cn: 读 rih-DEEM，长元音就是付出的价钱。

normal.en: The word buys back objects, reputations, souls and promises.
normal.cn: 这个词买回物品、名声、灵魂和诺言。

normal.en: Ask who pays and who is freed when the sum clears.
normal.cn: 问这笔钱结清时，谁付了钱，谁得到了自由。
