abstract.en: To redeem is to convert guilt into a receipt.
abstract.cn: 赎回就是把罪疚换成一张收据。

abstract.en: Every redemption assumes that what was lost can still be priced.
abstract.cn: 每一次救赎都预设失去之物仍然可以被标价。

abstract.en: The oldest meaning survives in the newest coupon.
abstract.cn: 最古老的意思活在最时髦的优惠券里。

examples.en: He redeemed the watch from the pawnshop before the month was out.
examples.cn: 月底之前，他把那块表从当铺赎回。

examples.en: One honest report redeemed a year of careless work.
examples.cn: 一份诚实的报告弥补了一整年的粗心工作。

examples.en: The voucher can be redeemed at any branch.
examples.cn: 这张代金券可在任何分店兑换。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）+ deem（买）→ 付钱把东西买回来。

root: 拉丁语 redimere（买回来）→ re- + emere（买）

sensesIntro.en: Five senses all pay a price: for an object, a reputation, a token, a soul, and a promise.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项都在付一笔价钱：为一件物、一份名声、一张券、一个灵魂，以及一句诺言。

branches.en: An object bought back with money.
branches.cn: 用钱买回来的物品。

branches.en: A reputation bought back with good work.
branches.cn: 用好工作买回的名声。

branches.en: A paper token exchanged for value.
branches.cn: 换成实物的纸券。

branches.en: A soul bought back from sin.
branches.cn: 从罪里被买回的灵魂。

branches.en: A fault and a promise are both debts.
branches.cn: 过失与诺言都是债。

intro.en: The redeem- family is about buying back: redemption, redeemable, redeemer and redemptive all keep the counter and the price.
intro.cn: redeem 词族讲的是买回：redemption、redeemable、redeemer、redemptive 都保留柜台与价钱的意象。

latinIntro.en: Latin emere, 'to buy', gives redimere, 'to buy back'; redemption is the noun of that transaction.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 emere（买）生出 redimere（买回来）；redemption 是这笔交易的名词形式。

definition_zh: 赎回；救赎；弥补；兑换
definition_en: the act of buying back, of being saved, of making good a failure, or of exchanging a token
core_image: 当票被撕成两半，旧的欠据烧掉，人在门口直起腰来
scene: 小说最后一章，那个曾经行骗的人在码头做苦工，把欠下的钱一笔笔还清。The last chapter turns on a long redemption that costs him everything.
sceneCN: 这里 redemption 指弥补、挽回（第 3 个义项：用代价把过错补上）；句意为最后一章讲一场漫长的弥补，代价是他的一切。

senses.title: The redemption of a pledge
senses.definition: the act of buying back property held as security
senses.definitionCN: 把作为担保被扣押的财物买回来的行为
senses.example: The redemption of the pledge had to wait until the harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 赎回那件抵押物一直要等到收成之后。
senses.why: The first sense is legal and financial: a debt is closed and the thing returns.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是法律与财务的：债被结清，东西回来。

senses.title: A story of redemption
senses.definition: the saving of a person from sin, guilt or a wasted life
senses.definitionCN: 把人从罪、罪疚或虚度的生活中救出来
senses.example: The novel is a slow story of redemption after a public disgrace.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说讲的是一个人在公开蒙羞之后缓慢的救赎。
senses.why: Here the price is paid in conscience rather than coin.
senses.whyCN: 这里付出的代价是良心，而不是钱币。

senses.title: The redemption of a failure
senses.definition: the act of making good a failure or restoring a damaged name
senses.definitionCN: 把一次失败补上，或把受损的名声修复
senses.example: The last chapter turns on a long redemption that costs him everything.
senses.exampleCN: 最后一章讲一场漫长的弥补，代价是他的一切。
senses.why: The sense measures repair, not rescue.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项衡量的是修补，而不是营救。

senses.title: The redemption of a coupon
senses.definition: the exchanging of a voucher or points for goods or value
senses.definitionCN: 把代金券或积分换成商品或价值
senses.example: Redemption of the coupon is limited to one per customer.
senses.exampleCN: 该券每位顾客只能兑换一次。
senses.why: Commerce reduces the word to a transaction at a till.
senses.whyCN: 商业把这个词缩小成收银台前的一笔交易。

intro.en: Redemption comes from Latin redemptio, 'a buying back', from redimere, 'to buy back'.
intro.cn: redemption 来自拉丁语 redemptio（买回来），源头是 redimere（买回）。

items.en: Emere meant to buy.
items.cn: emere 意为买。

items.en: The compound meant to buy a thing back.
items.cn: 这个复合词意为把东西买回来。

items.en: The noun named the whole transaction.
items.cn: 这个名词指整笔交易。

items.en: The church made it the word for salvation.
items.cn: 教会让它成为「救赎」的词。

items.en: Retail now uses it for vouchers and points.
items.cn: 零售业现在用它说代金券与积分。

note.en: The look-alike group is the redeem- family; the near-meaning group separates salvation, recovery, atonement and repurchase.
note.cn: 形近组是 redeem 词族；近义组把「拯救」「恢复」「赎罪」「回购」分开。

entries.definition: one who buys back or saves.
able to be exchanged for value.
the getting back of something lost.
the making up of an offence.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a pawn ticket torn in half and an old debt burned.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「当票被撕成两半，旧欠据被烧掉」的画面。

normal.en: Redemption is the noun behind redeem: the price has been paid.
normal.cn: redemption 是 redeem 背后的名词：价钱已经付了。

normal.en: Picture the two halves of the ticket falling apart.
normal.cn: 想象当票的两半各自落下来。

normal.en: Say rih-DEMP-shun; DEMP sits in the middle.
normal.cn: 读 rih-DEMP-shun，DEMP 在中间。

normal.en: The word covers pawnshops, pulpits and supermarket tills.
normal.cn: 这个词覆盖当铺、讲坛和超市收银台。

normal.en: Ask what was bought back, and what it cost the buyer.
normal.cn: 问买回的是什么，买的人又付出了什么。

abstract.en: Redemption is the receipt for a life that was nearly lost.
abstract.cn: 救赎是一个几乎失掉的人生的收据。

abstract.en: A redemption story needs a debt large enough to be interesting.
abstract.cn: 救赎故事需要一个足够大的债才好看。

abstract.en: The marketplace and the church use the same word for different gods.
abstract.cn: 市场与教堂用同一个词，敬不同的神。

examples.en: The redemption of the pledge had to wait until the harvest.
examples.cn: 赎回那件抵押物一直要等到收成之后。

examples.en: The novel is a slow story of redemption after a public disgrace.
examples.cn: 这部小说讲的是一个人在公开蒙羞之后缓慢的救赎。

examples.en: Redemption of the coupon is limited to one per customer.
examples.cn: 该券每位顾客只能兑换一次。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）+ demption（买回）→ 付清代价、把失去的取回来这件事。

root: 拉丁语 redemptio（买回来）→ redimere（买回）→ re- + emere（买）

sensesIntro.en: Four senses price four returns: property, a soul, a damaged name, and a paper voucher.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项给四种返回标价：财物、灵魂、受损的名声，以及一张纸券。

branches.en: Property bought back from a lender.
branches.cn: 从债主那里买回的财物。

branches.en: A person saved from guilt or ruin.
branches.cn: 从罪疚或毁灭中被救出的人。

branches.en: A damaged name repaired by effort.
branches.cn: 靠努力修好的名声。

branches.en: A voucher exchanged at a till.
branches.cn: 在收银台换成实物的券。

branches.en: Both close a paper claim with payment.
branches.cn: 两者都用付款结清一张纸上的请求。

intro.en: The word is the noun of redeem: emere, 'to buy', plus the re- that sends the purchase back to its owner.
intro.cn: 这个词是 redeem 的名词形式：emere（买）加上把这次购买送回原主的 re-。

latinIntro.en: Latin redemptio names the whole act; theology and retail each borrowed it and gave it a different price.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 redemptio 指整个行为；神学与零售业各自借走它，给了它不同的价码。

items.exampleCN: 他做出了救赎性的举动。

definition_zh: 使改变方向；改寄；重定向；引导（精力、资金）
definition_en: to change the direction of something, to send it to a new place, or to turn resources toward a new purpose
core_image: 路口一块临时路牌，把整条车流斜斜地引向旁边那条街
scene: 施工队在路上竖了一块临时指示牌，把车流引到旁边的街道。A temporary sign redirected the traffic into the next street.
sceneCN: 这里 redirect 指使改变方向（第 1 个义项：改变交通、水流等的走向）；句意为一块临时指示牌把车流引到旁边的街道。

pos.zh: 使改变方向；改寄；重定向；引导

senses.title: To redirect traffic
senses.definition: to change the course of vehicles, water or a moving flow
senses.definitionCN: 改变车辆、水流或任何流动之物的路线
senses.example: A temporary sign redirected the traffic into the next street.
senses.exampleCN: 一块临时指示牌把车流引到旁边的街道。
senses.why: The first sense is physical: a moving stream is turned to another channel.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是物理的：一股流动被引到另一条通道。

senses.title: To redirect a letter
senses.definition: to send a letter, call or address to a different destination
senses.definitionCN: 把信件、电话或地址送往另一个目的地
senses.example: The office redirected the letter to his new address.
senses.exampleCN: 办公室把那封信改寄到他的新地址。
senses.why: Here the flow is information, and it is sent elsewhere.
senses.whyCN: 这里的流动是信息，被送往别处。

senses.title: To redirect funds
senses.definition: to turn money, effort or attention toward a new purpose
senses.definitionCN: 把金钱、精力或注意力转向新的用途
senses.example: The board redirected the budget toward repairs.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会把预算转向修缮。
senses.why: The sense is strategic: the same resource, a new target.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项是战略性的：同一份资源，换了一个目标。

intro.en: Redirect is re-, 'again', plus direct, from Latin dirigere, 'to set straight'.
intro.cn: redirect 是 re-（再次）加 direct，后者来自拉丁语 dirigere（使成直线、指向）。

items.en: Regere meant to rule or to guide straight.
items.cn: regere 意为统治或引直。

items.en: Dirigere meant to set something in a straight line.
items.cn: dirigere 意为把某物摆成直线。

items.en: English direct kept the sense of pointing.
items.cn: 英语的 direct 保留了「指向」的意思。

items.en: The prefix adds a second pointing elsewhere.
items.cn: 前缀加上第二次指向别处。

items.en: Offices and networks made the word common.
items.cn: 办公室与网络让这个词流行起来。

note.en: The look-alike group is the direct- family; the near-meaning group separates reroute, divert, channel and reassign.
note.cn: 形近组是 direct 词族；近义组把「改线」「改道」「引导」「重新分配」分开。

entries.definition: the line along which something moves.
an instruction about what to do.
to send along a different route.
to turn aside from a course.
to guide through a particular path.
to give a new task or place.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a temporary sign bending a whole stream of cars into a side street.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一块临时路牌把整条车流弯进侧街」的画面。

normal.en: Redirect is re plus direct: the pointing happens again, elsewhere.
normal.cn: redirect 是 re 加 direct：指向再做一次，指向别处。

normal.en: Picture the arrow on the sign turning forty degrees.
normal.cn: 想象牌子上的箭头转了四十度。

normal.en: Say ree-dih-REKT; the stress falls on REKT.
normal.cn: 读 ree-dih-REKT，重音在 REKT。

normal.en: Traffic, letters, money and attention can all be redirected.
normal.cn: 车流、信件、金钱和注意力都能被改向。

normal.en: Ask who raised the sign, and who pays for the detour.
normal.cn: 问是谁竖起了牌子，又是谁为绕路买单。

abstract.en: To redirect is to admit the original route was badly chosen.
abstract.cn: 改向就是承认原来的路线选错了。

abstract.en: Every detour is a small essay about priority.
abstract.cn: 每一次改道都是一篇关于优先级的小论文。

abstract.en: The word moves streams that have no opinion about their course.
abstract.cn: 这个词挪动的是对自己路线没有意见的流动。

examples.en: A temporary sign redirected the traffic into the next street.
examples.cn: 一块临时指示牌把车流引到旁边的街道。

examples.en: The office redirected the letter to his new address.
examples.cn: 办公室把那封信改寄到他的新地址。

examples.en: The board redirected the budget toward repairs.
examples.cn: 董事会把预算转向修缮。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（再）+ direct（指向）→ 把原来指向这边的，再指向别处。

root: 拉丁语 dirigere（使成直线、指向）→ re- + direct

sensesIntro.en: Three senses turn three flows: vehicles, information and resources.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项改的是三种流动：车辆、信息与资源。

branches.en: Vehicles or water sent along a new course.
branches.cn: 被引到新路线的车或水。

branches.en: A letter or call sent to another address.
branches.cn: 被送往另一地址的信或电话。

branches.en: Money or attention given a new target.
branches.cn: 被赋予新目标的钱或注意力。

branches.en: One turns a body, the other turns a message.
branches.cn: 一个转动实体，一个转动消息。

branches.en: Both decide where something should land.
branches.cn: 两者都在决定某物该落在哪里。

intro.en: The direct- family is about pointing: direct, direction, directive and director all stand on the Latin line of dirigere.
intro.cn: direct 词族讲的是「指向」：direct、direction、directive、director 都立在 dirigere 那条拉丁线上。

latinIntro.en: Latin dirigere, 'to set straight', gives direct; re- adds a second setting, this time toward a different point.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dirigere（摆直）给出 direct；re- 加上第二次摆放，这一次朝另一个点。

definition_zh: 令人敬畏的；难对付的；强大的
definition_en: worthy of fear and respect, especially because of strength, skill or reputation
core_image: 一位老将走进会场，争论声立刻低下去，所有人不自觉坐直
scene: 老将一走进会场，争论声立刻低了下去，所有人都坐直了身子。The redoubtable old general silenced the room simply by entering it.
sceneCN: 这里 redoubtable 指令人敬畏的（第 1 个义项：因力量或声望而让人心生敬畏）；句意为那位令人敬畏的老将一进门就让整个会场安静下来。

pos.zh: 令人敬畏的；难对付的；强大的

senses.title: A redoubtable opponent
senses.definition: of a person, commanding fear and respect by strength or skill
senses.definitionCN: 指人因力量或本领而让人既怕又敬
senses.example: The redoubtable old general silenced the room simply by entering it.
senses.exampleCN: 那位令人敬畏的老将一进门就让整个会场安静下来。
senses.why: The first sense is about a person in the room, felt at once.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项讲的是在场的一个人，感受是即时的。

senses.title: A redoubtable reputation
senses.definition: of a name or a record, strong enough to warn people in advance
senses.definitionCN: 指名声或战绩强到足以事先让人退让
senses.example: The firm had a redoubtable reputation for winning difficult cases.
senses.exampleCN: 这家事务所以能赢下难案而声名令人忌惮。
senses.why: Here the fear arrives before the person does.
senses.whyCN: 这里的畏惧在人来之前就已经到了。

intro.en: Redoubtable comes from Old French redoutable, from redouter, 'to fear greatly', built on douter, 'to doubt'.
intro.cn: redoubtable 来自古法语 redoutable，源头是 redouter（非常惧怕），构词基于 douter（怀疑）。

items.en: Dubitare meant to doubt or hesitate.
items.cn: dubitare 意为怀疑、迟疑。

items.en: Douter carried the sense of fearing as well as doubting.
items.cn: douter 同时有怀疑与惧怕之意。

items.en: Redouter meant to fear someone greatly.
items.cn: redouter 意为非常惧怕某人。

items.en: The adjective meant to be feared.
items.cn: 这个形容词意为「值得惧怕的」。

items.en: English softened fear into awe and respect.
items.cn: 英语把恐惧柔化成了敬畏与尊重。

note.en: The look-alike group is the doubt- family, which shares the root of hesitation; the near-meaning group separates formidable, daunting, awe-inspiring and fearsome.
note.cn: 形近组是 doubt 词族，共享「迟疑」的词根；近义组把「难对付的」「吓人的」「令人叹服的」「可怕的」分开。

entries.definition: feared and respected, in older use.
hard to deal with because of size or skill.
entries.definitionCN: 因规模或本领而难对付的。

entries.definition: filling a person with wonder and fear.
entries.definitionCN: 使人充满惊叹与敬畏的。

entries.definition: causing fear by appearance or strength.
entries.definitionCN: 因外表或力量引起恐惧的。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a room going quiet as an old general steps through the door.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「老将一跨进门，整个房间就安静下来」的画面。

normal.en: Redoubtable hides the word doubt: people are afraid to doubt him.
normal.cn: redoubtable 里藏着 doubt：没人敢怀疑他。

normal.en: Picture every back straightening as he walks in.
normal.cn: 想象他走进来时每一根脊背都挺直了。

normal.en: Say rih-DOW-tuh-bl; DOW carries the stress.
normal.cn: 读 rih-DOW-tuh-bl，重音在 DOW。

normal.en: It is fear in the first half, respect in the second.
normal.cn: 前半是恐惧，后半是尊重。

normal.en: Ask whether the fear comes from what he did or from what he might do.
normal.cn: 问这份畏惧来自他做过的事，还是他可能做的事。

abstract.en: Redoubtable is the compliment that still smells of threat.
abstract.cn: 令人敬畏是一个仍带着威胁气味的赞美。

abstract.en: A reputation becomes redoubtable when nobody wants to test it.
abstract.cn: 当没人愿意去试的时候，名声就变得令人忌惮。

abstract.en: The word grew out of doubt and settled into awe.
abstract.cn: 这个词从怀疑里长大，最后住进了敬畏。

examples.en: The redoubtable old general silenced the room simply by entering it.
examples.cn: 那位令人敬畏的老将一进门就让整个会场安静下来。

examples.en: The firm had a redoubtable reputation for winning difficult cases.
examples.cn: 这家事务所以能赢下难案而声名令人忌惮。

examples.en: She was redoubtable in debate, and no one interrupted her.
examples.cn: 她在辩论中令人忌惮，没有人敢打断她。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（加强）+ doubt（怀疑、惧怕）+ able → 让人不敢怀疑、也不敢轻视的。

root: 古法语 redoutable → redouter（惧怕）→ re- + douter（怀疑，拉丁语 dubitare）

sensesIntro.en: Two senses carry one threat: a person feared in the room, and a name feared before the person arrives.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项带着同一种威胁：在场就让人畏惧的人，以及人还没到名声先到的姓名。

branches.en: A present person who commands fear and respect.
branches.cn: 在场就令人又怕又敬的人。

branches.en: A reputation that warns before the person comes.
branches.cn: 在人来之前先发出警告的名声。

branches.en: One is felt in the body, the other heard in advance.
branches.cn: 一个在身体上感到，一个事先听到。

branches.en: Old generals and strong debaters fill the first sense.
branches.cn: 老将与强辩者填满第一个义项。

branches.en: Firms and families fill the second.
branches.cn: 事务所与家族填满第二个。

intro.en: The doubt- family is about hesitation: doubt, doubtful, doubtless and redoubtable all descend from dubitare.
intro.cn: doubt 词族讲的是迟疑：doubt、doubtful、doubtless、redoubtable 都出自 dubitare。

latinIntro.en: Latin dubitare, 'to doubt', became French douter, 'to fear'; the re- in redouter makes the fear very great.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dubitare（怀疑）变成法语 douter（惧怕）；redouter 里的 re- 把这份惧怕加大。
